title: Mobile app for employees and managers
App shell, sign-in and security
Employee opens the app with five tabs
story: As an employee, I want an installable app with Home, Time, Requests, Pay and Me tabs so that I can do my HR work on my phone.
acceptance: Given an employee opens the app link on Android Chrome, when the page loads, then an install prompt appears and the app opens with the five tabs (M04 §3, Q1).
Given a new employee-facing flow is added by any module, when it is released, then it has a mobile screen in the same wave and a row in the APX-D §5 tab map (YX-MOB-01).
Given a mid-range Android phone on a throttled 3G profile, when Home or Time is opened, then it is interactive in 3 s or less (YX-MOB-06).
Given the Home and Time tabs, when the build runs, then their JavaScript is 200 KB gzipped or less (YX-MOB-06).

title: Employee signs in with mobile OTP and unlocks with fingerprint or PIN
story: As an employee, I want to sign in with an OTP to my mobile number and then unlock with my fingerprint or a PIN so that I don't need a password.
acceptance: Given an invited employee enters their registered mobile number, when they enter the OTP, then they are signed in and asked to pick a language (M04 Q2, §6 first run).
Given OTP requests from one number, when the rate limit is reached, then more OTPs are refused, and each sent OTP counts toward the P04 SMS quota (M04 Q2).
Given a signed-in employee, when they set up a passkey or a 4-digit app PIN, then later opens use it instead of a new OTP (M04 Q2).
Given a personal device, when 30 days pass, then the session ends unless the company set a shorter time (M04 Q8).

title: Sensitive screens ask me to re-authenticate
story: As an employee, I want Pay, documents and bank or ID fields to ask for my fingerprint or PIN so that nobody else can see them on my phone.
acceptance: Given a signed-in employee, when they open Pay, documents or a bank / ID field, then the app asks for biometric or PIN first (YX-MOB-07).
Given the employee stays idle 15 minutes on one of these screens, when they act again, then they must re-authenticate (YX-MOB-07, M04 Q8).
Given an employee downloads a payslip PDF, when it opens, then it carries a watermark with their name and the download time (YX-MOB-07).

title: Employee or HR signs out a lost phone
story: As an employee who lost my phone, I want to sign it out from another device (or ask HR) so that nobody can use my account.
acceptance: Given an employee with two devices, when they choose Me › Security › Sign out on the lost device, then its sessions and push tokens are revoked at once (YX-MOB-09).
Given HR signs out an employee's device, when that device makes its next API call, then it gets 401 and push delivery to it stops (YX-MOB-09).
Given a device is revoked, when the app next opens, then the offline cache on it is cleared (M04 Q7).

title: Employee uses the app in Hindi, Tamil or Telugu
story: As an employee, I want the app in my language with local number and date formats so that I can read it easily.
acceptance: Given an employee picks Tamil, when they open any tab, then every label comes from the translation catalogue in Tamil (YX-MOB-10).
Given the locale is set, when amounts and dates show, then they use the user's locale format, e.g. ₹1,00,000 (YX-MOB-10).
Given the Home and Pay tabs in Tamil, when screenshots are checked in CI, then no label is cut off (YX-MOB-10).

title: Push notifications are grouped and open the right record
story: As an employee or manager, I want clear push notifications with names, grouped by subject, so that one tap takes me to the action.
acceptance: Given push is allowed, when a leave request is raised, then the manager sees 'Priya Sharma applied for leave 3–5 Oct', not an ID (YX-MOB-04).
Given several updates on one subject, when they arrive, then they are grouped into one notification (YX-MOB-04).
Given a notification is tapped, when the app opens, then it shows the record with its action (YX-MOB-04).
Given a payslip is ready, when push or WhatsApp is sent, then the text carries no amounts or ID data (P04 Q6).

title: App opens offline and keeps my drafts
story: As a field employee with a weak network, I want the app to open offline and save my drafts so that I can submit later.
acceptance: Given no network, when the employee opens the app, then cached Home, holidays, leave balances and the payslip list (no figures) show with an offline banner (M04 Q7).
Given the employee fills a leave, expense or regularisation form offline, when they tap submit, then it is saved on the phone with a 'pending sync' chip (M04 Q7).
Given the phone comes online, when the draft syncs, then the server checks balance and limits again and shows the result (M04 Q7).
Given sign-out or remote revoke, when it happens, then all cached data and drafts are removed from the device (M04 Q7, YX-MOB-09).

title: Each release is checked against mobile performance budgets
story: As a product owner, I want each mobile release checked against size, start time and crash budgets so that the app stays fast on cheap phones.
acceptance: Given a build over the download-size or cold-start budget on the 2 GB reference phone, when CI runs, then it fails and shows the measured value (YX-MOB-19).
Given a staged rollout, when crash-free users fall below 99.5 % over 7 days, then the rollout stops automatically (YX-MOB-19).
Given a user finishes a leave request successfully, when the rating rules allow, then the OS review prompt shows; never after an error and not again within 90 days (YX-MOB-19).
Given the budget values, when they change, then they are edited as config, not code (YX-MOB-19).

title: Time tab and check-in on the phone
Employee checks in from the check-in sheet
story: As an employee, I want the check-in sheet to show my shift, the map and why I can or can't check in so that I am never confused.
acceptance: Given an employee opens check-in, when the sheet loads, then it shows the shift, time to start and the location verdict with distance (YX-MOB-05).
Given GPS is available, when the sheet shows, then a map shows my pin, the accuracy circle and the allowed geofence, with a 'retry location' action (YX-MOB-18).
Given the employee is outside the geofence in restricted mode, when they tap check-in, then it is blocked with a plain reason such as 'Outside Chennai HQ, 850 m away' (YX-MOB-05, YX-MOB-18).
Given a refused or abandoned attempt, when it happens, then it is logged on the server and the sheet offers 'ask HR to regularise' in one tap (YX-MOB-18).

title: Employee checks in without signal
story: As an employee working in a basement, I want my check-in saved on the phone when there is no signal so that I am not marked absent.
acceptance: Given no network, when the employee checks in, then the punch is queued on the device with device time and GPS and shows 'pending sync' (YX-MOB-18, M04 G8).
Given the phone comes online, when the queue syncs, then the geofence verdict is computed on the server and HR sees the offline flag and device time (YX-MOB-18).
Given the server acknowledges the punch, when sync finishes, then the queued item is removed from the phone (M04 §4).

title: Company binds check-in to one phone per employee
story: As an HR admin, I want check-in tied to each employee's own phone so that nobody punches for a friend.
acceptance: Given binding is on for restricted-mode staff, when an employee checks in from a phone that is not bound, then the check-in is refused (YX-MOB-08).
Given binding is off or the employee is exempt, when they check in, then the device is still recorded on the punch (YX-MOB-08).
Given an employee changes phone, when they request a new binding, then it goes to HR / manager approval through P03 (M04 Q3).

title: Employee sees late, early and missing marks on the Time calendar
story: As an employee, I want my attendance calendar to mark late, early, missing and OT days so that I can fix problems fast.
acceptance: Given attendance data, when the Time calendar shows, then late / early / missing / OT days are marked with the UI brief colours, and late is a warning colour, never success (YX-MOB-12).
Given many punches, when the employee opens a day, then punches are grouped under that day's card (YX-MOB-12).
Given any request sheet, when the employee fills it, then they are never asked to pick an approver (YX-MOB-12).

title: Requests and manager approvals on the phone
Employee raises any request from one sheet
story: As an employee, I want one request sheet for leave, attendance, expense and other requests so that I learn one way to ask.
acceptance: Given the Requests tab, when the employee taps new request, then every request type registered in P03 is listed (M04 §3).
Given a type is picked, when the form opens, then it shows a live summary such as leave balance after (M04 §6).
Given the form is submitted, when the approver is resolved, then P03 resolves it on the server and the employee never picks one (YX-MOB-12).
Given my requests list, when it opens, then each request shows its status and latest step (M04 §3).

title: Manager decides a request on an approval card
story: As a manager, I want an approval card with a summary and the impact so that I can decide in a few taps.
acceptance: Given a pending leave request, when the manager opens it from a push, then they can approve in 3 taps or fewer (YX-MOB-02).
Given the card, when it shows, then it has a summary, the impact (e.g. team availability) and approve / reject / send back with a comment (YX-MOB-02).
Given any approval, when the card shows, then the full form is never editable by the approver (YX-MOB-02).

title: Manager clears the approvals inbox
story: As a manager, I want an inbox with only the items waiting for me, grouped by type, so that I can clear it quickly.
acceptance: Given a manager with pending items, when the inbox opens, then only items awaiting their action show, grouped by type (YX-MOB-03).
Given drafts exist in the team, when the inbox loads, then drafts never appear (YX-MOB-03).
Given several low-risk items of one type, when the manager selects them, then they can approve them in bulk (YX-MOB-03).

title: Manager sees Team today and the team calendar
story: As a manager, I want to see who is in, late, on leave or not checked in today so that I can plan the day.
acceptance: Given a manager opens Home, when the Team segment loads, then it shows in / late / on leave / WFH / not checked in for their subtree (M04 Q5).
Given a team member with an attendance exception, when the manager taps nudge, then the employee gets a reminder (M04 Q5).
Given a team member's profile, when the manager opens it, then only fields in P02 scope show, and no salary unless enabled (M04 Q5).

title: Shared kiosk for workers without phones
Worker checks in at a shared kiosk with code and PIN
story: As a factory worker without a smartphone, I want to check in at a tablet with my code and PIN so that my attendance is recorded.
acceptance: Given HR registered a kiosk for a site, when a worker enters employee code + PIN or scans the ID-card QR, then the punch is saved with the kiosk id and location (M04 Q4).
Given the worker is signed in, when they finish, then they see leave balance and payslip summary and the kiosk logs out after 30 s (M04 Q4).
Given a kiosk stops sending heartbeats, when the limit passes, then HR is alerted (M04 Q4).

title: Worker applies for leave and sees request status at the kiosk
story: As a worker without the app, I want to apply for leave and see requests raised for me at the kiosk so that I am not left out.
acceptance: Given a worker signed in with code + PIN, when they pick a leave type and dates, then the request enters the normal P03 chain with channel 'kiosk' (YX-MOB-11).
Given HR or the supervisor raised a request on the worker's behalf, when the worker signs in, then a banner shows it with its status (YX-MOB-11).
Given a proxy request is decided, when the worker has no app, then they get an SMS or WhatsApp with no sensitive data (YX-MOB-11).
Given the worker is idle, when the kiosk timeout passes, then the session logs out (YX-MOB-11).

title: Store apps, Pay tab and non-employee app modes
Employee installs the Android or iOS store app
story: As an employee, I want the app from the Play Store or App Store so that push and fingerprint unlock work reliably.
acceptance: Given the Capacitor wrapper of the same code, when it is built, then Android and iOS store apps are published with native push (FCM / APNs) (M04 Q1).
Given the store app, when the employee unlocks it, then native biometrics are used (M04 Q2).
Given the store app and the PWA, when either is used, then they call the same API; only device registration and kiosk are mobile-only endpoints (M04 §6, YX-MOB-01).

title: Employee views the payslip on the phone
story: As an employee, I want to open my payslip after a push and see why each number is what it is so that I trust my pay.
acceptance: Given a payslip is published, when the push 'September payslip is ready' is tapped, then Pay opens after re-authentication (YX-MOB-07).
Given the payslip viewer, when the employee taps a line, then the 'why this number' drawer explains it (M04 §6).
Given the employee downloads the PDF, when it opens, then it carries the name and time watermark (YX-MOB-07).

title: Candidate uses the candidate mode of the app
story: As a candidate, I want a candidate mode of the app for my tests so that I can take Open or AI-only tests on my phone.
acceptance: Given a candidate signs in through the P02 external login, when the app opens, then only candidate screens show and never employee tabs (YX-MOB-17).
Given a test in Open or AI-only mode, when the candidate starts it, then it runs in the app with camera checks (YX-MOB-17).
Given a test needing the secure client or Record & review / Live / screen monitoring, when the candidate tries to start it, then the app refuses and tells them to use a desktop (YX-MOB-17).

title: Invigilator runs roll call in the invigilator mode
story: As an invigilator, I want an invigilator mode for my centre session so that I can check candidates in, even offline.
acceptance: Given an invigilator signs in with a device-bound passkey, when the app opens, then only their assigned centre session is available (YX-MOB-17).
Given roll call, when they scan an admit-card QR and check the photo ID, then the seat is confirmed and an incident can be logged (YX-MOB-17).
Given check-in photos were taken, when they sync to the server, then they are removed from the device (YX-MOB-17).

title: Benefits administration and flexible benefit plan
Benefit plans and policies
Benefits admin sets up plans from starter templates
story: As a benefits admin, I want to create insurance, FBP and NPS plans from starter templates so that we can offer benefits quickly.
acceptance: Given the Benefits setup card, when the admin starts, then starter templates are offered (GMC 3 L family floater, GPA, GTL, FBP heads, NPS) and clearly labelled as starters (YX-BEN-01).
Given a plan, when the admin sets eligibility (entity, grade, employment type, tenure) and cost sharing, then it is saved as a company policy with a dated plan year (YX-BEN-01).
Given a limit above a P07 legal cap, when the admin saves it, then it is refused with the cap shown (YX-BEN-01).
Given plan options (sum insured, top-up, member type), when saved, then each shows the employer and employee premium share (M11 §4).

title: HR adds its own benefit to the catalogue
story: As an HR admin, I want to add our own benefits like gym or childcare so that we don't need custom work.
acceptance: Given the generic catalogue, when HR creates a benefit of type 'other', then they choose eligibility, cost sharing and treatment (payroll, claim with bills, vendor payment) (YX-BEN-11).
Given a tax treatment, when HR picks it, then only P07 categories can be chosen (YX-BEN-11).
Given a custom benefit, when employees enrol, then it shows in enrolment, the benefit statement and cost reports like built-in ones (YX-BEN-11).

title: Insurance enrolment and endorsements
HR opens an enrolment window
story: As a benefits admin, I want to open enrolment windows so that employees enrol only at the right time.
acceptance: Given an open-enrolment window, when it opens, then eligible employees are notified (YX-BEN-02).
Given a joiner, when they join, then a joining window opens with the policy deadline (starter 30 days) (YX-BEN-02).
Given no window is open, when an employee tries to change coverage, then it is refused; only HR can change it, with a reason (YX-BEN-02).

title: Employee enrols with dependants and sees the premium
story: As an employee, I want to choose a plan option and add my family so that they are covered.
acceptance: Given an open window, when the employee chooses an option, then dependants are picked from their M01 family list (YX-BEN-02).
Given the choice, when it is shown, then the employee sees their premium share and the 80D tax effect before confirming (YX-BEN-04).
Given the employee confirms, when the enrolment is saved, then an endorsement is created and the e-card appears in Me › Benefits once issued (YX-BEN-03).
Given dependants' health data, when a manager opens the employee's profile, then they see none of it (YX-BEN-09).

title: Joining and exit create insurance endorsements
story: As a benefits admin, I want joiners added and leavers removed automatically so that coverage is always right.
acceptance: Given an employee joins on 10 Oct, when they are enrolled, then an add endorsement dated 10 Oct with pro-rata premium is created (YX-BEN-03).
Given an employee exits, when the LWD plus plan grace passes, then a delete endorsement is created (YX-BEN-03).
Given the endorsement queue, when HR opens it, then each item shows provider status draft / sent / accepted / rejected (M11 §4).

title: Employee reports a life event to add a dependant
story: As an employee who just had a baby, I want to report it with proof so that my child is covered.
acceptance: Given a marriage, birth, adoption, divorce or death, when the employee submits it with proof within the deadline, then HR gets a verify task (YX-BEN-02).
Given HR verifies it, when approved, then the dependant is added and an endorsement with pro-rata premium is created (YX-BEN-03).
Given the deadline has passed, when the employee tries, then only HR can make the change, with a reason (YX-BEN-02).

title: Premium share becomes a payroll deduction
story: As a payroll admin, I want employee premium shares deducted in payroll and 80D sent to the tax workspace so that pay and tax are correct.
acceptance: Given an enrolment with an employee share, when payroll runs, then the share and top-ups appear as deductions (YX-BEN-04).
Given an 80D-eligible amount, when it is deducted, then it flows to the tax workspace automatically (YX-BEN-04).
Given an employer-paid group premium, when payroll runs, then it is not taxable to the employee (YX-BEN-04).
Given a mid-month joiner, when October payroll runs, then the deduction is pro-rata (YX-BEN-03).

title: Benefits admin exports endorsements in the insurer's file format
story: As a benefits admin, I want endorsement files in the insurer's or broker's format so that I can upload them without a connector.
acceptance: Given no provider connector, when the admin exports, then pending endorsements download in the provider's file format (YX-BEN-10).
Given a connector add-on is enabled, when endorsements are ready, then they are sent by the connector instead (YX-BEN-10).
Given health data in the file, when it is produced, then only fields needed for coverage are included (YX-BEN-09).

title: Flexible benefit plan (FBP)
Employee allocates the FBP basket
story: As an employee, I want to split my FBP basket across heads like meal and fuel so that I save tax.
acceptance: Given a CTC template with an FBP basket, when the FY starts, then the basket amount is funded from compensation (YX-BEN-05).
Given the allocation window is open, when the employee allocates, then the server refuses a total above the basket (YX-BEN-05).
Given the window is closed, when the employee tries to change allocations, then it is refused (YX-BEN-05).
Given each head, when the employee allocates, then the tax effect under both regimes is shown first (YX-BEN-07).

title: Employee claims an FBP head with bills
story: As an employee, I want to claim an FBP head with my bills so that I get the money tax-free.
acceptance: Given a meal head with ₹2,200 left, when the employee claims ₹5,000, then the server verifies only ₹2,200 (YX-BEN-06).
Given a head's yearly total is reached, when the next month comes, then accrual stops for that head (YX-BEN-06).
Given a claim, when the verifier checks the bills, then the verified amount and verifier are recorded in the append-only ledger (YX-BEN-06).
Given a new-regime employee, when a non-exempt head is paid, then it is paid as taxable salary (YX-BEN-07).

title: Unclaimed FBP is paid as taxable salary at year end or exit
story: As a payroll admin, I want unclaimed FBP paid as taxable salary at year end so that Form 16 is right.
acceptance: Given ₹8,000 of unclaimed LTA at year end, when the sweep runs, then it is paid as taxable salary and shows in Form 16 (YX-BEN-06).
Given an employee exits mid-year, when F&F is calculated, then the FBP balance is settled in the F&F (YX-BEN-06).
Given the sweep, when it posts, then a ledger entry 'year-end taxable sweep' is written (YX-BEN-06).

title: Employer NPS and benefit statement
Payroll pays employer NPS within the legal limit
story: As a payroll admin, I want employer NPS as a % of basic + DA within the 80CCD(2) limit so that tax is right.
acceptance: Given an employee opted in, when payroll runs, then employer NPS is computed as the set % of basic + DA (YX-BEN-08).
Given the amount exceeds the P07 80CCD(2) limit for the employee's regime, when payroll runs, then the excess is taxable (YX-BEN-08).
Given the PRAN, when it is stored, then it is Special class (M11 §4).

title: Payroll admin sends the monthly NPS contribution file
story: As a payroll admin, I want the monthly NPS file for the POP so that contributions are deposited.
acceptance: Given a paid payroll month, when the admin exports, then the NPS contribution file is produced in the POP format (YX-BEN-10).
Given the file, when it is generated, then its totals reconcile to payroll and differences are shown (YX-BEN-08).
Given a POP API add-on, when enabled, then contributions are sent through it instead (YX-BEN-10).

title: Employee sees a total rewards statement
story: As an employee, I want one statement of my CTC, benefits and employer costs so that I know my full reward.
acceptance: Given Me › Benefits, when the employee opens the statement, then it lists CTC, each benefit (custom ones too) and employer costs (YX-BEN-11).
Given HR › Benefits, when HR opens the dashboard, then it shows enrolled / pending / waived and costs by plan and department (M11 §7).
Given a manager, when they view a team member, then benefit health data stays hidden (YX-BEN-09).

title: Employee lifecycle: onboarding, exit and F&F
Journey engine and checklists
HR builds onboarding and offboarding checklist templates
story: As an HR admin, I want checklist templates with owners and relative due dates so that every joiner and leaver gets the right tasks.
acceptance: Given a template per entity / department / role, when HR adds a task, then it has an owner (HR, IT, admin, manager, new hire), a due offset from the anchor date (negative allowed), dependencies and an SLA (YX-LC-02).
Given 'Collect PAN' at −7 days and a joining date, when the journey starts, then the task is due a week before joining (YX-LC-02).
Given a task's SLA passes, when it is still open, then the owner gets P04 reminders (YX-LC-02).
Given the same engine, when an exit case opens, then the offboarding template creates its tasks anchored on the LWD (YX-LC-02).

title: HR tracks joiners on the onboarding board
story: As an HR admin, I want a board of joiners with progress so that I see who is behind.
acceptance: Given journeys in progress, when HR opens the board, then cards sit in Offer accepted → Pre-boarding → Day 1 → First 30 days → Done (M01 §6).
Given a journey, when tasks complete, then the progress ring on the card and on the employee record updates (YX-LC-02).
Given HR opens a pre-boarding record, when sections are filled, then the completion % is visible (M01 §3.5).

title: Default templates include statutory joining and exit tasks
story: As a payroll admin, I want PF / ESI tasks in every default joining and exit template so that nothing statutory is missed.
acceptance: Given the default onboarding template, when it is used, then it has UAN generation / link, ESIC IP registration, Form 11 and Form 2 tasks owned by HR / payroll (YX-LC-22).

Given the default offboarding template, when an exit case opens, then it has EPFO date of exit, ESIC exit, gratuity Form L within 15 days of payability and PF transfer / withdrawal attestation, due relative to the LWD (YX-LC-22).
Given a missing UAN at payroll time, when M03 pre-flight runs, then it is flagged (YX-LC-22).

title: HR edits lifecycle policies from a labelled starter template
story: As an HR admin, I want our lifecycle policies (rehire, absconding, retirement, contract end, death support, open-case hold) to start from a template I can edit so that they match our company.
acceptance: Given a new company, when lifecycle settings open, then each policy shows a clearly labelled starter template (YX-LC-25).
Given HR changes a value, when saved, then it is a dated company setting and the change is audited (YX-LC-25).
Given a value below a legal minimum in P07, when HR saves it, then it is refused; a more generous value is allowed (YX-LC-25).

title: Pre-boarding and joining
Accepted offer hands off to pre-boarding
story: As an HR admin, I want an accepted offer to start pre-boarding (automatically or from a 'Ready to onboard' queue) so that nobody re-types data.
acceptance: Given the entity's hand-off mode is automatic, when a candidate accepts the offer, then a pre-boarding record is created (M01 §3.5, M10 Q2).
Given manual mode, when HR clicks 'Create employee' in the 'Ready to onboard' queue, then the record is pre-filled from the offer (M01 §3.5).
Given direct entry or a bulk import file, when HR uploads it, then a validation preview shows errors before records are created (M01 Q1).
Given a pre-boarder, when billing runs, then they are not counted as an active employee (YX-LC-12).

title: Onboarding branches by person type
story: As an HR admin, I want the system to know if the hire is new, a rehire, an internal mover or a contractor so that each follows the right path.
acceptance: Given a hire, when the person type is decided, then it comes from the P01 person record, not from the name or email (YX-LC-11).
Given an ex-employee, when hired again, then a new employment opens on the existing employee record, pre-filled from the old one (YX-LC-11).
Given an internal employee, when hired into a new role, then it is a P06 transfer / promotion on the release date agreed with the current manager, not an onboarding (YX-LC-11).

Given a contract worker converts, when the employment starts, then deployments, site attendance and register rows stay and show on the employee timeline; contract service counts for probation only if the company setting says so (YX-LC-30).

title: HR applies the rehire policy with an impact preview
story: As an HR admin, I want rehire options (code, PF, tax, service, gratuity, leave, probation, prior records) to default from our policy so that rehires are quick and correct.
acceptance: Given a rehire, when HR opens it, then each option defaults from the company rehire policy (starter: fresh start, same record, code and UAN) (YX-LC-18).
Given HR changes an option, when saving, then a reason is required and the override is audited (YX-LC-18).
Given the same entity and FY, when 'combine YTD' is chosen, then income and TDS are combined per PAN × TAN × FY for one Form 16 (YX-LC-18).
Given the choices, when HR confirms, then an impact preview shows what continues before saving (YX-LC-18).

title: Recruiter sees an 'Ex-employee' flag from the first screen
story: As a recruiter, I want past employees flagged as soon as they apply so that I know their rehire status early.
acceptance: Given an application linked to a person with a past employment, when it shows, then it is marked 'Ex-employee' from the first screen and through screening (YX-LC-29).
Given the recruiter or HR, when they open it, then they see exit date, exit type and the rehire-eligible flag; the hiring manager sees only 'Ex-employee' and yes / no (YX-LC-29, YX-LC-10).
Given a rehire-ineligible flag, when the recruiter moves the application past screening, then an alert shows; HR may clear it with a reason, and nothing is auto-rejected (YX-LC-29).
Given prior records and reasons, when shown, then visibility follows the rehire policy's prior-record setting (YX-LC-29, YX-LC-18).

title: New joiner completes the pre-boarding portal on the phone
story: As a new joiner, I want a simple mobile portal with OTP login to fill my details and upload documents before day 1 so that joining is smooth.
acceptance: Given an OTP login, when the joiner signs in, then they see the welcome page and the checklist configured for their entity / department / role (M01 Q2).
Given the forms, when the joiner fills personal, family & nominees, emergency, education, previous employment and previous-employer income, then progress is saved per section (M01 §3.5).
Given document uploads by camera, when submitted, then they are stored as P05 documents for HR to verify (M01 §3.5).
Given bank details, when entered, then they are auto-verified (P10) and the joiner picks the tax regime (M01 §3.5).

title: Every joiner gets an issued appointment letter
story: As an HR admin, I want an appointment-letter task in every onboarding template that I cannot remove so that we follow the OSH Code.
acceptance: Given any onboarding template, when it is edited, then the 'Issue appointment letter' task cannot be removed; only owner and offset can change (YX-LC-26).
Given a joiner of any employment type, when the P05 letter is issued, then the task completes (acceptance / e-sign tracked separately) (YX-LC-26).
Given the due date passes with no letter, when the next check runs, then HR and the compliance calendar get an alert and M03 pre-flight warns (YX-LC-26).
Given go-live, when HR runs the check, then employees with no letter on file are listed for bulk issue (YX-LC-26).

title: HR postpones a joining date and the journey moves
story: As an HR admin, I want to change a joining date and have every open task move with it so that I don't fix dates by hand.
acceptance: Given a pre-boarder, when HR changes the joining date, then every open task's due date moves by the same days (YX-LC-13).
Given the change, when saved, then draft compensation, assignment start and probation dates move too (YX-LC-13).
Given completed tasks, when the date changes, then they are untouched (YX-LC-13).

title: HR marks a pre-boarder as did not join, reneged or withdrawn
story: As an HR admin, I want one action to undo a hire who did not join so that the requisition reopens and no record is left half-done.
acceptance: Given 'did not join' or 'reneged', when HR records it with a reason, then employee, employment, draft compensation and pre-boarding login are cancelled (kept, not deleted) in one audited action (YX-LC-12).
Given the unwind, when it completes, then the M10 headcount-plan slot is released, the requisition reopens and the candidate is marked reneged (YX-LC-12).
Given the company withdraws an accepted offer, when HR does it, then a reason is mandatory, a withdrawal letter is issued, and it is never automatic (YX-LC-12).
Given a BGV discrepancy, when it is found, then HR is flagged and the offer is never withdrawn automatically (M01 §3.5 BGV).

title: HR runs a campus batch with long pre-boarding
story: As an HR admin, I want campus hires grouped in a batch with touchpoints over months so that they stay engaged until joining.
acceptance: Given a batch with a common joining date, when HR changes the batch date, then every member's journey re-anchors (YX-LC-24, YX-LC-13).
Given engagement touchpoints at offsets from joining, when their dates come, then messages, content or events are sent (YX-LC-24).
Given an LOI before the offer, when HR issues it, then it sits on the same pre-boarding record and the offer follows later (YX-LC-24).
Given months of pre-boarding, when billing runs, then the pre-boarders are not billed (YX-LC-24).

title: HR tracks background verification with consent
story: As an HR admin, I want BGV started after offer acceptance with the joiner's consent so that results are on file before confirmation.
acceptance: Given an accepted offer, when BGV starts (by default after acceptance), then the joiner gives consent first (M01 §3.5 BGV).
Given the partner add-on or manual tracking, when results arrive, then they are stored as documents (M01 §3.5).
Given an outcome gate such as 'clear before confirmation', when results are not clear, then the gate blocks that step and HR is told; the offer is never auto-withdrawn (M01 §3.5, YX-LC-12).

title: Manager assigns an onboarding buddy
story: As a manager, I want to give my new joiner a buddy from the team so that they settle in faster.
acceptance: Given pre-boarding, when HR or the manager assigns a buddy, then suggestions come from the same team / location and the manager can't be the buddy (YX-LC-33).
Given a buddy, when assigned, then buddy tasks (welcome call, day-1 lunch, 30-day check-in) and reminders are created from the template (YX-LC-33).
Given day 30 and day 90, when they arrive, then both sides get a short feedback form (YX-LC-33).
Given a buddy at the company cap, when HR tries to add another joiner, then it is refused (YX-LC-33).

title: Pre-boarder becomes an employee on the joining day
story: As an HR admin, I want a joiner to become an employee on day 1 with all pre-boarding data moved so that nobody types it again.
acceptance: Given the joining date or 'Mark joined', when it happens, then employment, first assignment and user account (+ SSO) are created (M01 §3.5).
Given pre-boarding data, when the person joins, then it becomes employee data without re-entry (YX-LC-03).
Given unverified mandatory documents, when payroll pre-flight runs, then they are flagged (YX-LC-03).
Given billing, when the person joins, then metering starts from the joining date (YX-LC-12).

title: Day-1 identity check before access is granted
story: As an HR admin, I want the joiner matched to the identity captured earlier before they get system access so that the right person joins.
acceptance: Given consent, when the joiner arrives on day 1, then they are matched against the identity-chain capture before access is granted (YX-LC-31).
Given a mismatch, when it happens, then an HR review flag is raised and joining is never auto-blocked (YX-LC-31).
Given face detection off, no capture or refused consent, when HR checks the original ID, then the HR attestation is recorded (YX-LC-31).

title: Asset issue and return (uses the M14 asset register)
IT issues an asset from the onboarding checklist
story: As an IT admin, I want an onboarding task to issue a laptop from the M14 asset register so that the joiner's assets are tracked.
acceptance: Given an 'issue asset' task, when IT completes it, then an assignment is created on the M14 asset record, not in a separate M01 register (M01 §3.6, M14).
Given the assignment, when it is made, then condition and issue date are recorded and the employee acknowledges by click or e-sign (M01 §3.6).
Given the employee's profile, when HR opens it, then assets held are listed from the M14 register (M01 §3.6, YX-LC-02).

title: Employee returns assets at exit and unreturned ones are recovered
story: As an admin, I want unreturned assets to flow into clearance and F&F so that we recover them.
acceptance: Given an exit case, when the LWD approaches, then every asset assigned in the M14 register shows as a clearance item (M01 §3.6).
Given an asset is returned, when IT records return date and condition in M14, then the clearance item closes (M01 §3.6).
Given an asset is not returned, when the F&F is calculated, then the recovery amount is pulled into F&F and refreshed until F&F approval (YX-LC-07).
Given a death-in-service exit, when assets are open, then the return is requested from the family and never recovered from dues without HR decision (YX-LC-16).

title: Resignation, exit case and clearance
Employee submits a resignation in the app
story: As an employee, I want to resign in the app and see my last working day so that the process is clear.
acceptance: Given the employee submits a reason and proposed last day, when it is saved, then the notice period comes from the policy valid on the submission date by grade, type and confirmation status (YX-LC-04).
Given the submission, when it routes, then manager and HR accept it through P03 (M01 Q6).
Given acceptance, when it is done, then the standard LWD is shown and the employee badge reads 'Serving notice' (M01 §3.7).
Given mobile, when the employee resigns, then the same flow works in Requests (YX-MOB-01).

title: Manager agrees early release, buy-out or withdrawal
story: As a manager, I want to approve early release, buy-out or withdrawal of a resignation so that every change is recorded.
acceptance: Given an early release or buy-out request, when it is approved, then the shortfall is computed and recorded on the exit case (YX-LC-04).
Given withdrawal before acceptance, when the employee withdraws, then it is free; after acceptance, it needs approval (YX-LC-04).
Given the company pays notice in lieu, when approved, then it becomes an F&F earnings line (YX-LC-06).

title: Leave during notice shows its effect on the exit case
story: As an HR admin, I want leave taken in the notice period handled by our per-leave-type policy so that the LWD and F&F are right.
acceptance: Given a leave type set to 'extends LWD', when it is approved during notice, then the approved LWD moves and the employee is told (YX-LC-21).
Given earned leave may offset a notice shortfall, when the policy allows, then the F&F notice-shortfall line is reduced and explained (YX-LC-21).
Given 'blocked' or 'LOP', when the employee applies, then the M02 rule applies and the exit case shows the effect (YX-LC-21).

title: HR opens an exit case of any type with pre-checks
story: As an HR admin, I want to open an exit case for termination, retirement or other types and be warned about open cases so that nothing is missed.
acceptance: Given any exit type, when the case opens, then the system checks for open POSH / disciplinary cases where the person is respondent and for open PIPs, and flags them to HR only (never POSH to the manager) (YX-LC-23).
Given the open-case policy (starter: hold), when a flag exists, then relieving / experience letters and / or F&F are held pending the outcome, and HR may release them (YX-LC-23).
Given a hold, when a legal deadline comes, then statutory dues are still paid on time (YX-LC-23, YX-LC-08).
Given the case continues after exit, when the person leaves, then they keep alumni-scoped access to it (YX-LC-23).

title: Department owners sign off clearance
story: As a department owner, I want my clearance items on the exit case so that I can sign off handover, IT, assets, finance and HR documents.
acceptance: Given an exit case, when clearance starts, then items are created for manager handover, IT access, admin / assets, finance advances and expenses, and HR documents (M01 §3.7).
Given an owner signs off, when they add a note and an optional recovery amount, then the item closes (M01 §4).
Given open clearance items, when HR tries to finalise the F&F, then it is blocked, but the exit itself is not (M01 §3.7).
Given open clearance, when the F&F due date comes, then the due date does not move (YX-LC-08).

title: Leaver completes a confidential exit interview
story: As a leaver, I want to give honest exit feedback that my manager can't see so that I can speak freely.
acceptance: Given an exit case, when the exit interview is sent, then the leaver answers reasons, ratings and would-rejoin (M01 §3.7).
Given answers marked confidential, when the manager opens the case, then they cannot see them; only HR roles can (YX-LC-09).
Given answers, when they are submitted, then they feed P09 attrition analytics (M01 §3.7).

title: HR records rehire eligibility, regretted exit and backfill
story: As an HR admin, I want to mark rehire eligibility, a regretted exit and a backfill request so that hiring and analytics use them.
acceptance: Given an exit case, when HR sets rehire-eligible with a reason, then it is HR-only and shows when the person reappears in the ATS (YX-LC-10).
Given 'regretted', when HR sets it, then it is never shown to the leaver or manager and feeds P09 regretted attrition (M01 §3.7).
Given 'backfill requested', when the exit is accepted, then M10 opens a replacement requisition linked to the exit that reuses the leaver's plan line (YX-LC-15).
Given no backfill, when N days (default 30) after the LWD pass, then the plan line is released (YX-LC-15).

title: Access switches to alumni on the last working day
story: As an HR admin, I want access to change automatically on the LWD so that the leaver keeps only alumni access.
acceptance: Given the LWD ends, when `employment.exited` fires, then the login converts to alumni and implicit grants end (YX-LC-05).
Given open approvals waiting on the leaver, when the LWD comes, then they are reassigned (YX-LC-05).
Given pending onboarding / exit tasks owned by the leaver, when the LWD comes, then they are escalated (YX-LC-05).

title: Exit case shows a deprovisioning panel
story: As an HR admin, I want to see every module's clean-up for a leaver with its status so that no access is left behind.
acceptance: Given modules registered `employment.exited` and LWD-approaching handlers, when the exit runs, then the panel shows one row per handler with pending / done / failed (YX-LC-14).
Given a handler fails, when it retries and still fails, then HR is alerted and can retry by hand (YX-LC-14).
Given handlers timed at LWD, T+0 and T+N, when each time comes, then the action runs (e.g. devices revoked at T+0, approvals reassigned at LWD) (YX-LC-14).
Given Ravi's LWD has passed, when his phone calls the API, then it gets 401, his API key is revoked and his delegation has ended (YX-LC-14).

title: Full and final settlement
Payroll admin calculates the F&F with explained lines
story: As a payroll admin, I want the F&F calculated as an off-cycle payroll run with every line explained so that the leaver trusts the numbers.
acceptance: Given an exit case, when the F&F runs, then earnings include final-month salary, leave encashment, bonus, gratuity, reimbursements, arrears and notice pay in lieu (YX-LC-06).
Given recoveries, when the F&F runs, then notice shortfall, negative leave, advances, loans, assets, training bond and bonus clawback are deducted (YX-LC-06).
Given every line, when HR or the leaver opens it, then 'how it's calculated' is shown (YX-LC-06).
Given TDS, when the F&F runs, then it is recomputed for the year's final income (YX-LC-06).

title: Open advances, loans and recoveries are pulled into F&F automatically
story: As a payroll admin, I want open advances, loans, assets, negative leave, bonds and clawbacks pulled in automatically so that nothing is missed.
acceptance: Given Meera has an unsettled ₹5,000 expense advance, when her F&F is calculated, then it is recovered as a line (YX-LC-07).
Given an advance is settled after the first calculation, when the F&F is refreshed before approval, then the line updates (YX-LC-07).
Given the F&F is approved, when new items appear, then they no longer change it automatically (YX-LC-07).
Given a training-bond recovery, when HR has not confirmed or waived it, then it is not pulled in (YX-LC-07).

title: F&F wages are due within 2 working days of the LWD
story: As a payroll admin, I want a countdown to the legal F&F deadline so that we always pay on time.
acceptance: Given Anjali's LWD is Friday 30 Oct, when the exit is approved, then the wage due date is Tuesday 3 Nov on the entity's working-day calendar (YX-LC-08).
Given an open laptop return, a hold or a missing payee, when the due date nears, then it does not move and the case records why payment is pending (YX-LC-08).
Given wage lines are ready, when HR pays them first, then the rest can be settled in a second F&F run (YX-LC-08).
Given the due date passes unpaid, when the check runs, then HR / payroll get an overdue flag (YX-LC-08).

title: F&F is approved, paid and the statement letter issued
story: As a payroll admin, I want F&F approval, payment and the statement letter in one flow so that the case closes cleanly.
acceptance: Given a calculated F&F, when it is submitted, then it goes through P03 approval (YX-LC-06).
Given approval, when payment runs, then the bank file / payout is created and the F&F statement letter is issued (YX-LC-06).
Given a recalculation before payment, when HR runs it, then it replaces the draft; after payment, changes follow P06 / P08 corrections (M01 §3.8).

title: Fixed-term staff get pro-rata gratuity after 1 year
story: As a payroll admin, I want fixed-term employees with a year's service to get pro-rata gratuity so that we follow the SS Code.
acceptance: Given Nikhil (fixed-term, 2 years 5 months), when his F&F is calculated, then pro-rata gratuity for 2 years is a line with its basis explained (YX-LC-28).
Given a 10-month fixed-term contract, when the F&F is calculated, then no gratuity is paid (YX-LC-28).
Given service before 21 Nov 2025, when counted, then the P07 transition rule applies, and the 5-year condition is not used for fixed-term (YX-LC-28).

title: Special exit types
HR records a death in service with a compassionate flow
story: As an HR admin, I want a dedicated death-in-service flow so that the family is treated with care and access is closed at once.
acceptance: Given HR records the date of death with the certificate, when saved, then every deprovisioning handler runs at once and LWD = date of death (YX-LC-16).
Given the death flow, when it runs, then no exit interview and no employee sign-offs are created; HR closes the employee's items (YX-LC-16).
Given letters, when they are issued, then they are addressed to the next of kin (condolence, dues statement, claim guidance) (YX-LC-16).
Given the company support policy (starter: all items off), when HR has set ex-gratia or salary continuation, then they apply on top (YX-LC-16).

title: F&F after a death is paid to nominees or legal heirs
story: As a payroll admin, I want the F&F split among nominees by their shares so that the right family members are paid.
acceptance: Given gratuity nominations wife 60 % / son 40 %, when the F&F is approved, then two payments are made to penny-drop-verified accounts (YX-LC-16).
Given no valid nomination, when HR tries to approve the F&F, then it is blocked until legal heirs with a succession document are recorded (YX-LC-16).
Given 3 years' service, when gratuity is computed, then the 5-year condition is waived, and leave encashment goes to the nominee (YX-LC-16).
Given tax, when dues are paid, then the P07 heir treatment applies and Form 16 is issued to the legal heir (YX-LC-16).

title: Family gets a claims checklist and limited document access
story: As a nominee, I want a simple login to download the F&F statement, Form 16 and claim papers so that I can file family claims.
acceptance: Given a death exit, when the case is created, then a forms checklist for EDLI, EPS family pension, PF, ESI dependant benefit and gratuity is shown with company attestation tasks (YX-LC-16).
Given a nominee or legal heir, when HR grants access, then they get an OTP alumni-style login limited to the F&F statement, Form 16 and claim documents (YX-LC-16).
Given the access end date, when it passes, then the login stops working (M01 §4).

title: Absconding timeline runs from unauthorised absence
story: As an HR admin, I want an absconding timeline to start from unexplained absence so that we follow a fair, documented process.
acceptance: Given an employee absent without leave, when day 3 comes (starter template), then salary is put on hold in M03 and manager and HR are alerted (YX-LC-17).
Given days 7 and 14, when they come, then notice 1 and notice 2 letters go by email and registered post with dispatch details recorded (YX-LC-17).
Given the employee returns, when HR stops the timeline, then the absence is regularised in M02 and salary is released; HR can also resume it (YX-LC-17).
Given every step, when it runs, then it is audited on the case, and the day counts follow the company's edited policy (YX-LC-17, YX-LC-25).

title: Deemed abandonment gives a recovery-only F&F
story: As an HR admin, I want deemed abandonment to close the employment with a recovery-only F&F so that dues are held, not lost.
acceptance: Given day 21 (starter), when it comes, then an absconding exit case opens with LWD = last day present (YX-LC-17).
Given the F&F, when it is calculated, then recoveries apply and any net payable is held until claimed, never forfeited (YX-LC-17).
Given abandonment, when it is recorded, then a rehire-ineligible flag is set that HR may clear, and deprovisioning runs (YX-LC-17).
Given a held payable, when the wage due date comes, then the countdown keeps running and the case records why payment is pending (YX-LC-08).

title: Retirement case opens from the retirement policy
story: As an HR admin, I want retirements to open automatically from date of birth and our policy so that we prepare in time.
acceptance: Given the retirement age per employment type / grade (starter 58, end of month), when the alert lead time comes (starter 6, 3, 1 months), then an exit case of type retirement opens with the computed LWD (YX-LC-20).
Given an extension, when approved, then it is a dated change moving the date (YX-LC-20).
Given re-employment, when HR starts it, then it is a fixed-term 'retired re-employed' employment with no probation and no EPS (YX-LC-20).
Given the exit, when processed, then gratuity payout and the PF final-settlement checklist are triggered (YX-LC-20).

title: Fixed-term, intern and apprentice contracts end by policy
story: As an HR admin, I want reminders before a fixed-term contract ends and a choice to extend, convert or exit so that no contract runs out unnoticed.
acceptance: Given a fixed-term / intern / apprentice employment, when it is created, then it carries `contract_end_on` and its statutory treatment comes from P07, not M01 (YX-LC-19).
Given the contract-end policy (starter: alert at 30 and 7 days), when those days come, then HR and the manager are alerted (YX-LC-19).
Given extend or convert to permanent, when chosen, then it is a dated change (YX-LC-19).
Given 'auto-exit' and no action, when `contract_end_on` comes, then an end-of-contract exit case opens with LWD = `contract_end_on` (YX-LC-19).

title: HR runs a retrenchment with notice and compensation
story: As an HR admin, I want retrenchment handled per the IR Code so that notice, compensation and the re-skilling fund are right.
acceptance: Given a retrenchment exit case, when HR opens it, then it records the reason, the selection basis (with the seniority list for the category) and continuous service (YX-LC-27).
Given notice, when HR chooses, then written notice per `IN.IR` is issued or wages in lieu become an F&F line, and the notice to government is a task (YX-LC-27).
Given at least 1 year of service, when F&F is calculated, then compensation of 15 days' average pay per completed year is an earnings line (YX-LC-27).
Given each retrenched worker, when the case is approved, then a Worker Re-skilling Fund payable of 15 days' last-drawn wages appears in the compliance calendar (YX-LC-27).

title: Retrenchment, lay-off and closure need government permission at 300+ workers
story: As an HR admin, I want a permission request recorded before a large retrenchment, lay-off or closure so that we don't act without approval.
acceptance: Given an establishment at or above the `IN.IR` threshold (currently 300), when HR tries to approve a retrenchment, then it is blocked until a permission request is granted or deemed granted (YX-LC-27).
Given a refusal, when HR records it, then the retrenchment is cancelled (YX-LC-27).
Given a lay-off, when recorded with affected workers and dates, then the days reach M02 / M03 as a status with lay-off compensation per `IN.IR` (YX-LC-27).
Given a closure, when its permission is granted, then retrenchment-type exit cases open for everyone affected in bulk (YX-LC-27).

title: HR runs a voluntary retirement scheme
story: As an HR admin, I want a VRS window that employees can apply to so that the scheme benefit and dues are paid correctly.
acceptance: Given a VRS scheme with eligibility and benefit rules (P19), a window and approval, when an eligible employee applies inside the window, then an exit case of type VRS opens (YX-LC-32).
Given approval, when the F&F is calculated, then the VRS benefit is a line with its basis, plus gratuity and leave encashment (YX-LC-32).
Given tax, when the benefit is paid, then the P07 `IN.IT` treatment applies (YX-LC-32).

title: Exit letters and alumni access
HR issues relieving and experience letters
story: As an HR admin, I want relieving and experience letters issued from templates at exit so that the leaver gets them on time.
acceptance: Given an exit case with clearance done, when HR issues letters, then relieving and experience letters are generated from P05 templates (M01 §3.7).
Given an open-case hold, when HR tries to issue them, then they stay held until the case outcome or an HR release with a reason (YX-LC-23).
Given issued letters, when the person becomes alumni, then they can download them from the alumni portal (YX-LC-05).

title: Former employee downloads documents from the alumni portal
story: As a former employee, I want to log in after leaving and download my payslips, Form 16 and letters so that I have proof for my next job.
acceptance: Given an alumni login, when the person signs in, then they see only their own documents and letters (YX-LC-05, P05).
Given 7 years after exit, when the period ends, then alumni access ends (P05).
Given the person applies again, when the ATS matches them, then the ex-employee flag shows (YX-LC-29).

title: Cases and policies: POSH, accidents, grievance, disciplinary, whistleblower
Confidential case engine
Only case members can see a case
story: As an HR admin, I want each case to have its own named team so that nobody else sees confidential matters.
acceptance: Given an HR admin who is not a case member, when they open a grievance, then they get 403 and the attempt is audited (YX-CASE-02).
Given a respondent, when a complaint is filed, then they are not told until the process formally notifies them (YX-CASE-02).
Given every read of a case, when it happens, then it is audited and shown in P08 'who accessed' (M08 §4).
Given a case, when anyone tries to delete it, then it is refused; it can only be closed with an outcome, and each stage has a due date and reminders (YX-CASE-05).

title: Employee files a complaint in their own name or anonymously
story: As an employee, I want to file a complaint as myself or anonymously so that I feel safe to speak up.
acceptance: Given an employee files a case, when it is saved, then 'raised by' is always the logged-in user, or empty when anonymous (YX-CASE-01).
Given an employee tries to file in a colleague's name, when they submit, then it is refused (YX-CASE-01).
Given an anonymous complaint, when the case team opens it, then they see 'Anonymous', can message only through the anonymous channel, and no identity is stored in the row (YX-CASE-03).
Given the complainant later chooses to reveal identity, when they do, then it is recorded from that point (YX-CASE-03).

title: System blocks case members with a conflict of interest
story: As an HR admin, I want people with a conflict blocked from a case so that the inquiry is fair.
acceptance: Given the respondent, their manager chain, or someone who self-declares, when added to the case, then they are blocked (YX-CASE-04).
Given a real need to add such a person, when HR overrides, then a documented reason is required and audited (YX-CASE-04).
Given a member declares a conflict mid-case, when they do, then their access ends (YX-CASE-04).

title: Case updates outside the app reveal nothing
story: As a complainant, I want messages outside the app to say only that there is an update so that nobody learns about my case.
acceptance: Given any case update, when an email, SMS, push or WhatsApp is sent, then it says only 'You have an update on a confidential matter' with an in-app link (YX-CASE-06).
Given the case workspace, when any screen or PDF shows, then it carries a 'Confidential' watermark (M08 §7).
Given quiet hours, when a case message is due, then P04 quiet hours apply (YX-CASE-06).

title: Complainant raises a retaliation flag
story: As a complainant, I want to report retaliation at any time so that I am protected.
acceptance: Given an open or closed case, when the complainant raises a retaliation flag, then a linked case is created (YX-CASE-08).
Given the flag, when it is raised, then the case owner is alerted (YX-CASE-08).
Given the linked case, when it opens, then the same membership-only access applies (YX-CASE-02).

title: Case includes a contractor, vendor or visitor as a party
story: As an HR admin, I want to record an external complainant or respondent so that cases with non-employees are handled.
acceptance: Given an external party, when HR adds them, then name, employer, contact and party type are recorded (YX-CASE-09).
Given an external respondent, when a notice is sent, then delivery to them and to their employer's named contact is logged on the timeline (YX-CASE-09).
Given an external complainant, when they file or follow the case, then they use the OTP external login scoped to that case only (YX-CASE-09).

title: Case continues when a party leaves the company
story: As an IC member, I want a case to continue after the complainant or respondent leaves so that it is completed properly.
acceptance: Given a party exits, when their LWD passes, then the case continues and the ex-employee keeps case-scoped alumni access (YX-CASE-10).
Given an ex-employee within the POSH window, when they file a complaint, then they can do it through alumni-scoped access (YX-CASE-10).
Given an exit case opens for a party, when the pre-check runs, then HR sees a flag that names no case details outside the case team (YX-CASE-10).

title: Closed cases are kept 8 years and can be put on legal hold
story: As a compliance owner, I want closed cases retained and protected by legal hold so that we meet legal duties.
acceptance: Given a closed case, when 8 years pass from closure, then it is archived (encrypted, restricted restore) unless the company extended the period (M08 Q7).
Given a legal hold flag, when archive or deletion would run, then it is blocked (M08 Q7, YX-CASE-05).
Given case documents, when stored, then they are encrypted with a per-case key (M08 §4).

title: POSH complaints and Internal Committee
HR sets up the Internal Committee and sees if it is valid
story: As an HR admin, I want to record our Internal Committee and see if it meets the law so that we stay compliant.
acceptance: Given an entity at or above the P07 POSH threshold, when it has no valid IC, then a banner and a compliance-calendar item show (YX-POSH-01).
Given IC members, when saved, then the composition is checked against P07 (senior woman presiding, at least half women, one external member, tenure 3 years or less) (YX-POSH-01).
Given an IC with no external member, when the console opens, then it shows 'Committee not valid' (YX-POSH-01).
Given the external member, when they need access, then they get a limited OTP login that is not a billed seat (M08 Q4).

title: Aggrieved woman files a POSH complaint
story: As an aggrieved woman, I want to file a POSH complaint (or have someone file for me) to the IC so that it is handled under the law.
acceptance: Given an incident date, when a complaint is filed within 3 months, then it is accepted and routed only to the IC (YX-POSH-02).
Given more than 3 months have passed, when the IC extends the window by up to 3 more with reasons, then filing is allowed (YX-POSH-02).
Given someone files on her behalf, when submitted, then the filer and the aggrieved woman are both recorded (YX-POSH-02).

title: IC sees the statutory POSH clock on each case
story: As an IC member, I want the legal due dates calculated and escalated so that we never miss the 90-day inquiry limit.
acceptance: Given a complaint filed on 1 Oct, when the case opens, then the inquiry due date shows 30 Dec, with escalation at 75 days (YX-POSH-03).
Given the P07 POSH parameters, when the case moves, then due dates for notice to the respondent (7 days), report (10 days after inquiry) and employer action (60 days) are calculated (YX-POSH-03).
Given a due date nears, when reminders run, then IC members are escalated (YX-POSH-03).

title: Complainant asks for conciliation
story: As a complainant, I want conciliation only if I ask for it so that I am never pushed into a settlement.
acceptance: Given a POSH case, when the complainant requests conciliation, then the IC can record it; otherwise the option is not offered (YX-POSH-04).
Given a conciliation, when the terms are recorded, then a monetary settlement cannot be its basis (YX-POSH-04).
Given conciliation fails or is not chosen, when the IC proceeds, then the inquiry steps run (M08 §6).

title: Only IC members on the case see POSH details
story: As a complainant, I want only the IC members on my case to see it so that my privacy is protected.
acceptance: Given a POSH case, when HR opens the POSH area, then HR sees only anonymised counts and the actions assigned to it (YX-POSH-05).
Given System Admin or YukthiX support, when they try to access POSH data, then it is never shown, even in support sessions (YX-POSH-05, M08 Q4).
Given performance or other modules, when they read employee data, then POSH case details are never used (YX-POSH-05).

title: IC runs the inquiry and sends the report
story: As an IC member, I want to send notices, hold hearings and record the report so that the inquiry is documented.
acceptance: Given an inquiry, when the IC sends notice to the respondent, then the P05 POSH letter is issued and the event goes on the timeline (YX-POSH-03).
Given hearings, when they are held, then statements and documents are added to the case (M08 §6).
Given the IC report with a recommendation, when submitted, then the employer action due date (60 days) starts and the appeal window is noted (YX-POSH-03).

title: IC compiles and submits the POSH annual report
story: As an IC presiding officer, I want the annual report built from cases and awareness sessions so that we file it on time.
acceptance: Given the year's closed cases, when the report is built, then counts come from cases in the P07 format and due date (YX-POSH-06).
Given wave 4, when awareness sessions are held, then HR records them in a manual log (date, audience, attendance) used by the report; from wave 5 they come from M07 (YX-POSH-06).
Given the report is not submitted by the due date, when the check runs, then the compliance calendar flags it (YX-POSH-06).
Given submission, when HR marks it, then submission to the employer and the District Officer is recorded (YX-POSH-06).

title: Workplace accident and injury
Anyone reports a workplace accident
story: As a supervisor, I want to report an accident from my phone so that the safety officer and HR act fast.
acceptance: Given an employee, supervisor, security staff or contractor supervisor, when they report an accident, then a case opens for the location's safety officer and HR and the reporter is a member (YX-CASE-14).

Given the incident record, when filled, then it has the person (employee, or contract worker linked to M13), time, place, description, witnesses, photos, injury, body part, first aid, hospital and days unable to work (YX-CASE-14).
Given someone reports a near-miss, when they pick a case type, then the accident type is not offered (YX-CASE-14).

title: Medical details stay private and the register is filled on close
story: As a safety officer, I want medical details visible only to members with medical access and the register filled automatically so that privacy and the law are both met.
acceptance: Given diagnosis, certificates and disablement, when stored, then they are Special and shown only to case members with medical access (YX-CASE-14).
Given the manager, when they look at the injured employee, then they see only the injury leave dates (YX-CASE-14).
Given the case closes, when it closes, then one entry is written to the statutory accidents register with no re-keying (YX-CASE-14).
Given a correction after the register is signed, when made, then a new signed version is created (YX-CASE-14).

title: Case generates the ESIC accident report and statutory notice
story: As a safety officer, I want the ESIC report and the accident notice pre-filled with their deadlines so that we file on time.
acceptance: Given an ESI-covered person, when the case is saved, then the ESIC accident report is generated with its due time on the compliance calendar (YX-CASE-15).
Given a reportable accident (death, or disablement beyond the P07 days), when saved, then the statutory accident notice is generated in the prescribed form (YX-CASE-15).
Given a report is filed, when the officer marks it submitted, then the acknowledgement number is recorded; a missed deadline shows the P07 estimated penalty (YX-CASE-15).
Given a contract worker, when the contractor has not filed, then the principal employer is alerted (YX-CASE-15).

title: HR tracks an Employees' Compensation claim for non-ESI staff
story: As an HR admin, I want the EC amount computed and its deadline tracked so that injured staff not under ESI are paid right.
acceptance: Given a person not covered by ESI, when the case is saved, then an EC claim opens; ESI-covered persons get no EC claim (YX-CASE-16).
Given the P07 `IN.EC` rule valid on the accident date, when computed, then injury kind, wage with ceiling, age factor, minimums and waiting period are used (YX-CASE-16).
Given temporary disablement, when paid, then it goes through payroll; a lump sum is paid or deposited with the commissioner where P07 requires, with the reference recorded (YX-CASE-16).
Given payment after the due date, when recorded, then P07 interest and penalty lines are added, and the EC letter states the amount and calculation (YX-CASE-16).

title: Collective disputes and settlements
HR-IR records a collective dispute and its settlement
story: As an HR-IR officer, I want to record a union's charter of demands, conciliation and the signed settlement so that pay terms reach payroll.
acceptance: Given a union or worker group raises demands, when HR-IR records the dispute, then demands, conciliation events and outcome are on the case; the team is HR-IR and legal (YX-CASE-18).
Given a signed settlement, when uploaded as a P05 document, then effective dates and covered categories are recorded and it is sent to the authority where the IR Code requires (YX-CASE-18).
Given signing, when it is done, then pay terms go to M03 for settlement arrears and the settlement is linked from the union's register entry (YX-CASE-18).

title: Contract labour (CLRA / OSH Code) compliance
Tenant as contractor (staffing agency duties)
Staffing company records its own contractor licences per client site
story: As an HR admin at a staffing company, I want our contractor licences recorded per client establishment so that we only deploy within the licence.
acceptance: Given an entity flagged as contractor, when HR adds a client establishment, then the licence covering it (per site, or a scoped OSH Code licence) is linked (YX-CLRA-15).
Given a licence allowing 50, when HR deploys a 51st guard to that client site, then it is blocked (YX-CLRA-15).
Given no valid licence covering the site, when HR deploys, then it is blocked with the reason (YX-CLRA-15).

title: Staffing company sends each client a monthly compliance pack
story: As an HR admin at a staffing company, I want a monthly pack per client built from our payroll so that clients get proof on time.
acceptance: Given a wage month, when payroll is paid, then a pack per client establishment is built from M02 / M03 (wage register, muster, PF ECR / TRRN, ESI challan, wage proof, PT / LWF) (YX-CLRA-15).
Given the client's due date (company setting), when HR uploads to the client portal, then the date, reference and acknowledgement document are recorded (YX-CLRA-15).
Given an overdue or missing upload, when the due date passes, then HR and the account owner are alerted (YX-CLRA-15).

title: Expenses, advances and travel
Expense categories and policies
Finance sets up expense categories
story: As a finance admin, I want categories with accounting head, taxability, GST flag and receipt rule so that every claim posts correctly.
acceptance: Given a category, when finance saves it, then it has an accounting head, taxability, GST-eligible flag and receipt threshold (M05 §3).
Given the default receipt rule, when no change is made, then a receipt is mandatory above ₹500 and below it a self-declaration is used (YX-EXP-03).
Given a taxable category, when its claims are paid, then they flow to M03 as taxable reimbursement (YX-EXP-10).

title: Finance builds the expense policy matrix
story: As a finance admin, I want limits per category × grade × city tier, per line, day, trip and month, so that policy is clear.
acceptance: Given the matrix editor, when finance sets limits, then they are saved as a dated policy version (M05 Q1, YX-EXP-01).
Given shipped templates by grade band and city tier, when a company starts, then they can be used and edited (M05 §8).
Given a category, when finance sets it to hard block, then over-limit lines are blocked instead of escalated (YX-EXP-02).

title: Finance sets mileage and per-diem rates
story: As a finance admin, I want mileage rates per vehicle and per-diem rates per city tier and country so that these lines are computed.
acceptance: Given dated mileage rates, when an employee claims 42 km by car, then the amount is km × rate and can't be typed (YX-EXP-03).
Given per-diem rates by tier or country, when an employee claims 3 days, then the amount is days × rate (YX-EXP-03).
Given a rate change, when a new rate is dated, then old lines keep the rate valid on their expense date (YX-EXP-01).

title: Claims and approvals
Employee snaps a receipt and OCR fills the line
story: As an employee, I want to photograph a receipt and have the line filled for me so that claiming is fast.
acceptance: Given a receipt photo, when uploaded, then OCR pre-fills merchant, date, amount and GST fields (M05 Q4).
Given OCR results, when shown, then they are only pre-fill; the employee confirms the category and OCR never approves (M05 Q4).
Given each line, when saved, then it has exactly one receipt where the receipt rule needs one (YX-EXP-03).
Given OCR usage, when it runs, then it is metered in AI credits (M05 Q4).

title: Employee sees the policy check on each line before submitting
story: As an employee, I want to see if a line breaks policy before I submit so that I can fix it.
acceptance: Given a line, when entered, then it is checked against the policy on its expense date: limit, receipt rule, rate and category for the grade (YX-EXP-01).
Given a ₹1,00,000 taxi line with no receipt, when checked, then it is blocked or flagged per policy (YX-EXP-01, YX-EXP-03).
Given the results, when the approver opens the claim, then they see the same flags (YX-EXP-01).

title: Over-limit line needs a justification and an extra approver
story: As an employee, I want to claim more than the limit with a reason so that genuine costs are still paid.
acceptance: Given an over-limit line, when submitted, then a justification is required and an extra approval step (default department head) is added for the excess (YX-EXP-02).
Given a hard-block category, when the line is over the limit, then it can't be submitted (YX-EXP-02).
Given over-limit lines, when P09 spend analytics runs, then they are counted (M05 Q7).

title: System flags duplicate claims
story: As a finance user, I want duplicates flagged across the company so that nobody is paid twice.
acceptance: Given the same employee, amount, date and merchant, when a line is added, then it is flagged to the approver and finance (YX-EXP-04).
Given an identical receipt image hash uploaded by another employee, when submitted, then it is blocked (YX-EXP-04).
Given the same GST invoice number from the same supplier anywhere in the tenant, when added, then it is flagged (YX-EXP-04).

title: Finance turns on GST capture for input credit
story: As a finance admin, I want GST details captured on eligible lines so that we can claim input credit.
acceptance: Given GST capture is on (off by default), when a GST-eligible line is added, then supplier GSTIN, invoice no. / date, taxable value and CGST / SGST / IGST are captured (M05 Q5).
Given a GSTIN, when entered, then its format and state code are checked against the entity's GSTIN (M05 Q5).
Given two lines at different GST rates, when saved, then each keeps its own tax (M05 §9).
Given approved claims, when the journal posts, then GST input lines are included and the GST report lists them (YX-EXP-11).

title: Employee submits a claim and sees 'You will receive ₹X'
story: As an employee, I want to see how much I will receive on every screen so that I am never confused.
acceptance: Given a claim, when it shows on the claim, list, mobile or reports, then net payable (approved − advance adjusted) is the first figure (YX-EXP-06).
Given submission, when the approver is set, then it comes from the P03 chain on the server; a client-chosen approver is ignored (YX-EXP-05).
Given amount-based routing, when it applies, then it uses the claim total (YX-EXP-05).
Given offline, when the employee submits, then the draft syncs later (M04 Q7).

title: Manager approves a claim with changes
story: As a manager, I want to approve, reduce, send back or reject lines from the approval card so that I control spend.
acceptance: Given the approval card, when opened, then lines show policy flags, duplicates and receipt thumbnails (M05 §6).
Given the approver cuts ₹800, when saving, then a reason is required and the employee sees 'Approved ₹1,200 of ₹2,000 — hotel cap Tier 2' (YX-EXP-02).
Given approval, when the status changes, then it is separate from payment status (YX-EXP-07).

title: Finance reviews flagged claims before payment
story: As a finance user, I want a review queue for flagged claims so that risky claims get a final check.
acceptance: Given claims with duplicates, missing GST or over-limit lines, when approved, then they enter the finance queue if the company uses the audit step (M05 §6).
Given the queue, when finance opens a claim, then the receipt viewer shows beside the lines (M05 §7).
Given finance decides, when done, then the claim moves to payment or back with a reason (YX-EXP-04).

title: Trips and advances
Employee requests a trip with an advance
story: As an employee, I want to request a trip with purpose, dates, legs and an advance so that my travel is approved before I go.
acceptance: Given any employee, when they open Requests, then a trip request is available (YX-EXP-08).
Given the request, when approved through P03, then the approved advance creates an advance record automatically (YX-EXP-08).
Given the trip, when claims are added, then they are linked to it as their parent (M05 §3).

title: Travel desk uploads bookings to the trip
story: As a travel desk user, I want to upload tickets and hotel bookings to a trip so that company-paid costs count against the budget.
acceptance: Given a trip, when the employee, admin or travel desk uploads a booking, then it is attached to the trip (M05 Q3).
Given a company-paid booking, when recorded, then it counts against the trip budget but is not reimbursed (M05 Q3).
Given the trip timeline, when opened, then bookings, advance and claims show in order (M05 §7).

title: Employee settles a trip advance
story: As an employee, I want to see my advance against my spend so that I know if I must return money.
acceptance: Given an advance of ₹10,000 and claims of ₹7,000, when the settlement shows, then ₹3,000 to return or recover is shown (YX-EXP-06).
Given the employee repays by bank transfer, when finance confirms, then the advance is settled (M05 Q6).
Given the employee exits with an open balance, when F&F is calculated, then it appears there (YX-EXP-09).

title: Unsettled advances are reminded and then recovered from salary
story: As a finance user, I want old unsettled advances reminded and then recovered in instalments so that money comes back.
acceptance: Given an advance unsettled 30 days after the trip ends (default), when the check runs, then the employee gets reminders (YX-EXP-09).
Given reminders fail, when recovery starts, then up to 3 instalments (company sets) become one-time deductions in M03, respecting protected net pay (M05 Q6, YX-EXP-09).
Given payroll defers a recovery, when `recovery.deferred` arrives, then the remaining instalments shift and the open balance is kept (YX-EXP-13).

title: Payment and accounting
Finance pays claims through payroll or direct payout
story: As a finance user, I want approved claims paid in the next payroll or by direct payout so that urgent claims are paid fast.
acceptance: Given the company default, when a claim is approved before the payroll cut-off, then it is paid in the next payroll (M05 Q2).
Given an urgent or high amount, when finance chooses direct payout, then a bank file / payout entry is created (M05 Q2).
Given a claim approved but not yet paid, when the employee views it, then it shows 'Approved — payment in October payroll' (YX-EXP-07).

title: Claim payment status follows payroll events
story: As an employee, I want my claim marked paid only when the money is really paid so that the status is true.
acceptance: Given `payroll.run.paid`, when it arrives, then payroll-routed claims are marked paid and `expense.claim.paid` is emitted (YX-EXP-13, YX-EXP-07).
Given `payroll.run.voided`, when it arrives, then those claims return to approved-unpaid for the next run (YX-EXP-13).
Given `payment.failed`, when it arrives, then the claim shows 'payment failed' and finance can re-route it (YX-EXP-13).
Given the same event twice, when processed, then nothing changes the second time (YX-EXP-13).

title: Paid claims are locked and corrected with an adjustment line
story: As a finance user, I want paid claims locked so that the trail stays clean.
acceptance: Given a paid claim, when anyone tries to edit a line, then it is refused (YX-EXP-12).
Given a correction, when finance adds it, then it is a new adjustment line, positive or recovery (YX-EXP-12).
Given foreign-currency lines on a paid claim, when rates change later, then the used rates never change (YX-EXP-14).

title: Taxable reimbursements flow to payroll tax
story: As a payroll admin, I want taxable expense categories sent to M03 so that TDS is right.
