acceptance: Given a taxable category per P07 and company settings, when a claim is paid, then the amount flows to M03 as taxable reimbursement (YX-EXP-10).
Given an exempt category, when paid, then TDS is not affected (YX-EXP-10).
Given the employee's tax workspace, when opened, then taxable reimbursements are listed (YX-EXP-10).

title: Finance exports expense journals to accounting
story: As a finance user, I want approved claims posted to Tally or Zoho with heads, GST and cost centres so that the books are right.
acceptance: Given approved claims, when the journal is exported, then lines carry expense head, GST input when captured, cost centre and employee payable (YX-EXP-11).
Given the export, when run, then Tally, Zoho Books, CSV or the Accounting API is used (YX-EXP-11).
Given a claim with no cost centre chosen, when posted, then it uses the employee's assignment cost centre (M05, P01 Q8).

title: Foreign currency and field mileage
Employee claims a foreign-currency bill
story: As an employee travelling abroad, I want to claim a bill in its own currency and be paid in rupees so that I don't convert it myself.
acceptance: Given an AED 1,200 bill on 12 Nov, when added, then it converts at the company FX source (starter: RBI reference rate for 12 Nov) and the line shows rate, source and date (YX-EXP-14).
Given the employee enters her forex-card rate with the statement, when it differs by more than 3 %, then the approver sees a variance flag (YX-EXP-14).
Given policy limits, when checked, then country per-diem rows use their own currency and others use the pay currency (YX-EXP-14).
Given the approver, when they open the line, then both amounts show (YX-EXP-14).

title: Forex advance is settled in its own currency
story: As a finance user, I want a forex advance settled in its own currency with a clear exchange difference so that the books are right.
acceptance: Given a USD 500 advance and USD 420 spent, when settled, then USD 80 is to be returned (YX-EXP-15).
Given the return on 30 Nov, when recorded, then the INR value uses the 30 Nov rate and the exchange difference is its own line (YX-EXP-15).
Given the journal, when exported, then the exchange difference posts to the company's exchange-difference account (YX-EXP-15).

title: Field-force distance arrives as a draft mileage line
story: As a field employee, I want my day's tracked distance turned into a draft mileage line so that I claim it with one tap.
acceptance: Given a 42 km duty day from M02, when the day ends, then one draft mileage line is created for that day (YX-EXP-16).
Given the draft, when the employee has not confirmed it, then it is not submitted (YX-EXP-16).
Given the employee edits the distance, when the approver opens it, then the system distance is shown beside it (YX-EXP-16).
Given the confirmed line, when processed, then ordinary mileage rates, limits and approvals apply (YX-EXP-16, YX-EXP-03).

title: Performance, skills and career growth
Skills library and competencies
HR sets up one company skills library
story: As an HR admin, I want one skills library from a starter taxonomy plus our own skills so that competencies, question tags and scorecards all use the same skills.
acceptance: Given a new company, when the library opens, then the YukthiX starter taxonomy (domain → skill → sub-skill with levels) is labelled as a starter (YX-PERF-20).
Given competencies, T01 question tags and M10 scorecard skills, when they use a skill, then they reference the same library row (YX-PERF-20).
Given a skill in use, when HR tries to delete it, then it is refused; it can only be retired or merged, and every view follows (YX-PERF-20).

title: Employee confirms AI-suggested skills
story: As an employee, I want AI to suggest skills from my tests, courses and projects and let me confirm them so that my skill profile stays true.
acceptance: Given an AI suggestion of 'SQL' from a test result, when created, then it stays pending until the employee or manager confirms it (YX-PERF-20).
Given a rejected suggestion, when the same evidence is seen again, then it is not re-offered (YX-PERF-20).
Given confirmed skills, when shown, then each shows its source (self, manager, test, course, project, AI-confirmed) (YX-PERF-20).
Given paths, IDPs, pools or recommendations, when they use skills, then pending ones are ignored (YX-PERF-20).

title: HR maps competencies and levels to designations
story: As an HR admin, I want competencies with levels mapped to designations so that reviews and gaps use them.
acceptance: Given the shipped library (core, functional, leadership), when HR adds custom competencies, then they map to the skills library (M06 Q8, YX-PERF-20).
Given a designation, when HR maps required levels, then they are saved for review templates and career paths (M06 Q8).
Given a gap in a review, when found, then `perf.skill_gap.found` is emitted to M07 training needs (M06 Q8).

title: Goals, check-ins and feedback
Employee sets goals that align to team goals
story: As an employee, I want to set OKRs or KPIs and align them to my manager's or company goals so that my work connects to the plan.
acceptance: Given an OKR with key results, when progress is updated, then goal progress is calculated from key results and can't be typed (YX-PERF-01).
Given a parent goal owned by anyone, when Arjun aligns 'close 3 accounts' under Priya's team objective, then it is saved (YX-PERF-01).
Given a goal with children, when children progress, then the parent shows their weighted progress (YX-PERF-01).
Given goals for a period, when submitted, then the manager approves them (M06 §6).

title: Manager and employee hold 1-on-1s and goal check-ins
story: As a manager, I want 1-on-1s with a shared agenda, shared and private notes and action items so that we track progress together.
acceptance: Given a 1-on-1, when created, then it has a shared agenda, shared notes, private notes per author and action items that can link to goals (M06 §3).
Given a private note, when the other person opens the 1-on-1, then they can't see it (M06 §3).
Given a goal check-in from mobile, when submitted, then the key-result actual updates progress (YX-PERF-01).

title: Employee gives quick feedback to a colleague
story: As an employee, I want to give quick praise or suggestions any time from my phone so that feedback is not just yearly.
acceptance: Given any colleague, when quick feedback is sent outside a review, then it follows its visibility setting (YX-PERF-04).
Given a review is open, when someone not nominated tries to give 360° feedback on it, then it is refused (YX-PERF-04).
Given mobile, when the employee taps quick feedback, then it works in a few taps (M06 §7, YX-MOB-01).

title: Review cycles
HR builds a review template with weighted sections
story: As an HR admin, I want review templates with weighted sections and a score formula checked on save so that reviews never break mid-cycle.
acceptance: Given sections for goals, competencies, values, questions and overall rating, when HR sets weights, then they are saved (M06 §3).
Given an invalid final-score formula, when the template is saved, then it is rejected and existing reviews are unaffected (M06 §9).
Given a rating scale (default 1–5 with labels), when the cycle uses it, then the final score maps to a band label (YX-PERF-07).
Given shipped templates (annual, half-yearly, probation, OKR quarterly), when a company starts, then they are available (M06 §8).

title: HR launches a cycle with eligibility and proration
story: As an HR admin, I want each employee's eligibility decided by our rules when a cycle starts so that joiners, leavers and people on leave are treated fairly.
acceptance: Given an Apr–Mar cycle with a 3-month cut-off, when launched, then a February joiner is excluded (or gets a probation review) (YX-PERF-21).
Given a July joiner, when increments are computed, then they are prorated 9/12 (YX-PERF-21).
Given 6 months' maternity leave, when the cycle runs, then the rating is protected and the increment is not prorated down (YX-PERF-21).
Given an override, when HR changes eligibility, then a reason is required and audited; cycles of different types may overlap (YX-PERF-21, M06 §3).

title: Employee always sees the current stage and next step
story: As an employee, I want to see where my review is and what comes next so that I am never left guessing.
acceptance: Given configured stages (default self → 360° → manager → skip-level → calibration → release → acknowledgement), when the cycle runs, then each stage has an owner and a deadline (YX-PERF-06).
Given a deadline nears, when reminders run, then P03 reminds and escalates (YX-PERF-06).
Given the review workspace, when the employee opens it, then the current stage and next step are shown (YX-PERF-06).

title: Manager completes a review that counts only completed sections
story: As a manager, I want scores to use only completed sections so that a half-done review never shows a wrong number.
acceptance: Given only a self review is done, when the score shows, then it says 'Manager review pending', not 0.4/5 (YX-PERF-02).
Given a section without goals, when scored, then it is excluded with a warning (YX-PERF-02).
Given peer feedback, when shown, then it is labelled advisory and not averaged into the manager rating unless the template says so (YX-PERF-03).
Given the final score, when shown, then its band label is shown with it (YX-PERF-07).

title: Employee nominates 360° reviewers and feedback stays anonymous
story: As an employee, I want to nominate reviewers that my manager approves, and peers to stay anonymous, so that feedback is honest.
acceptance: Given min / max counts, when the employee nominates and the manager approves, then only approved reviewers can give feedback (YX-PERF-04).
Given peers are anonymous, when fewer than 3 responses exist in a group, then they are merged into 'others' or held back (YX-PERF-05).
Given anonymous reviewers, when HR views the review, then their identities are not shown in the UI (M06 Q4).
Given manager feedback, when shown, then it is named (M06 Q4).

title: HR runs a calibration session with reasons
story: As an HR admin, I want a calibration board with the distribution against a guide so that ratings are fair across teams.
acceptance: Given a group, when the session opens, then manager ratings and a distribution chart against the guide (no forced curve) show (M06 Q5).
Given a rating moved from 4 to 3, when saved, then before, after, reason and who are recorded (YX-PERF-08).
Given calibration changes, when the employee views their review, then they see only the released final rating (YX-PERF-08).

title: HR releases ratings and employees acknowledge
story: As an HR admin, I want ratings released only at the release step so that employees see final results together.
acceptance: Given the release step, when HR releases, then employees see their rating for the first time (YX-PERF-09).
Given the employee acknowledges, when they add a comment or disagreement flag, then the rating does not change and the flag routes to HR (M06 Q2).
Given a released review, when HR reopens it, then a reason is required and audited (YX-PERF-09).

title: HR clicks cycle funnel counts to see names

title: Learning and development

Given the package reports completion and score, when it does, then the enrolment uses them (YX-LRN-09).
Given the runtime state, when the employee leaves and returns, then they resume where they stopped (M07 §4).

title: Employee sees My learning on the phone

Given certificates, when listed, then each opens the P05 document (YX-LRN-02).
Given mobile, when used, then every learning flow works there (YX-MOB-01).

title: Enrolment and sessions

Given a course with an assessment, when enrolled, then a T03 employee test invitation is created automatically and shows in Me › My tests (M07 §3).

Given the session page, when opened, then attendees, attendance, results, feedback and cost are all on one record (YX-LRN-08).
Given an employee exits, when their LWD comes, then their future seats are released (M01 §3.7).

Given the trainer, when billing runs, then they are not a billed seat (M07 Q6).
Given N days after the session's last date, when they try to sign in, then access has ended (M07 Q6).

Given a connector without reports, when the class ends, then the join-link log is used (YX-LRN-11).

acceptance: Given a session course, when attendance is at or above the threshold, then it can complete (YX-LRN-01).

Given an attached assessment, when the T03 result is below the pass score, then it is not completed (YX-LRN-01).
Given completion, when recorded, then `learning.enrolment.completed` is emitted (M07 §6).

title: Completion issues a certificate and updates skills

Given 'Advanced Excel' mapped to level 3, when completed, then Excel rises from 2 to 3 on the skills profile with evidence linked (YX-LRN-03).
Given the certificate's validity, when issued, then its expiry date is stored (M07 §4).

Given the employee exits, when they look later, then they still keep the badge (YX-LRN-13).

acceptance: Given a webhook for a Teams / Slack channel, when an announcement is published, then post text and a link back are sent (M09 Q7).
Given key announcements, when WhatsApp is on, then they go by the company number (M09 Q7).
Given comments, kudos and surveys, when they happen, then they stay in YukthiX (M09 Q7).

title: Recognition and rewards
Employee gives kudos tagged with a company value
story: As an employee, I want to thank a colleague with kudos tied to a company value so that good work is seen.
acceptance: Given kudos, when given, then it must name a company value and may carry a badge (YX-ENG-06).
Given kudos, when posted, then it shows in the relevant space and the receiver is notified (M09 §6).
Given a review period, when the employee and manager open the review, then kudos show as context grouped by value, never scored, and the employee can hide individual kudos (M09 Q6).

title: Kudos can carry reward points with limits
story: As an HR admin, I want points with budgets and approval above a threshold so that rewards are fair.
acceptance: Given points mode, when a manager gives points, then they come from the monthly manager budget or peer allowance (M09 Q4).
Given someone tries to give points to themselves, or above the limit to their own manager chain, when submitted, then it is refused (YX-ENG-06).
Given points above the approval threshold, when given, then manager / HR approval is needed (YX-ENG-06).

title: Employee redeems points and tax is handled
story: As an employee, I want to redeem points for vouchers or a payroll payout so that I enjoy my reward.
acceptance: Given points, when redeemed as a voucher or payroll payout, then a redemption is created, with approval if needed (M09 Q4).
Given ₹6,000 redeemed as a voucher, when sent to M03, then a taxable one-time pay line is created above the gift threshold (YX-ENG-07).
Given `payroll.run.paid`, when it arrives, then payroll-route redemptions are marked paid (M09 §6).

title: Celebrations
Birthdays, anniversaries, joiners and promotions are celebrated
story: As an employee, I want birthdays and work anniversaries posted automatically, unless I opt out, so that we celebrate together.
acceptance: Given today's birthdays, when the daily job runs, then posts appear in the right spaces without the year (YX-ENG-08).
Given an employee opted out of birthdays, when the job runs, then no birthday post is made (YX-ENG-08).
Given a promotion, when the promotion letter is issued, then a celebration posts if the company allows (M09 Q5).
Given P02 directory settings, when a celebration shows, then they are respected (YX-ENG-08).

title: Surveys, eNPS and action plans
HR builds and sends a survey
story: As an HR admin, I want to build engagement, pulse and eNPS surveys from templates with an audience and schedule so that we hear from staff.
acceptance: Given templates (engagement, pulse, eNPS, onboarding 30/60/90, exit), when HR builds a survey, then questions reuse the assessment question types plus rating / NPS (M09 §2).
Given the anonymity mode, when employees open the survey, then it is shown before they answer and can't change after launch (M09 Q3).
Given an anonymous survey, when responses are stored, then they hold no user id; invitations track only answered / not for reminders (YX-ENG-04).
Given `employee.joined` or `exit.case.accepted`, when they fire, then onboarding or exit surveys are sent (M09 §6).

title: HR and managers see survey results with small groups hidden
story: As a manager, I want my team's survey results only when enough people answered so that nobody can be identified.
acceptance: Given an anonymous pulse with 4 responses in Accounts, when viewed, then it shows 'Not enough responses to display' (YX-ENG-04).
Given a filter that would narrow a group below the minimum, when HR tries it, then it is disabled, for HR admins too (YX-ENG-04).
Given free-text comments, when shown, then no metadata is shown (YX-ENG-04).
Given eNPS, when the group meets the minimum, then eNPS = % promoters (9–10) − % detractors (0–6) (YX-ENG-05).

title: Manager creates an action plan after results
story: As a manager, I want to create an action plan from my team results within 30 days so that we act on feedback.
acceptance: Given team results meet the minimum, when released, then the manager must create an action plan within 30 days, with reminders (M09 Q8).
Given a team below the minimum, when results release, then it rolls up to the parent group (M09 Q8, YX-ENG-04).
Given action plans, when HR opens them, then completion shows (M09 Q8).

title: HR sees engagement analytics
story: As an HR admin, I want active users, participation, recognition by value and eNPS trend so that I can track engagement.
acceptance: Given Engage data, when the dashboard opens, then metrics come from P09 with small-group suppression (YX-ENG-10).
Given recognition, when shown, then it is broken down by value and team (YX-ENG-10).
Given comment themes, when AI summarises them, then only anonymous text is used under P10 tiers (M09 §7).

title: Recruiting sends a candidate experience survey
story: As a recruiting ops user, I want to survey candidates after a test or interview so that we improve hiring.
acceptance: Given the company enabled a trigger (starter: all off), when a candidate completes the step, then one survey is sent per candidate per trigger, never before a result or decision is released (YX-ENG-11).
Given the survey, when answered, then it never affects scoring, stage or decision and is never visible to interviewers or evaluators (YX-ENG-11).
Given anonymous mode, when stored, then only coarse slice keys are kept; confidential-linked mode is stated in the intro and visible only with `survey.candidate.view` (YX-ENG-11).
Given an under-18 candidate, when surveyed, then only anonymous mode is used; cNPS shows with small-group suppression (YX-ENG-11).

title: Projects, timesheets and client billing
Projects, tasks and allocations
Shared client master and invoice engine is ready
story: As a finance user, I want one client master and invoice engine with GST and numbering so that projects (and later staffing) bill the same way.
acceptance: Given a client with GSTIN per state, billing contacts, terms and currency, when saved, then it is one record used by projects and staffing (M12 §3).
Given an invoice, when issued, then numbering is per entity / GSTIN and GST uses place of supply from the client GSTIN (YX-PRJ-11).
Given an issued invoice, when someone tries to edit it, then it is refused; corrections are credit notes (YX-PRJ-11).
Given e-invoicing, when the GSP add-on is on, then the IRN is requested (YX-PRJ-11).

title: PM creates a project with tasks and budgets
story: As a project manager, I want to create a project with client, billing model, budgets and tasks so that time and cost are tracked.
acceptance: Given a project, when saved, then the code is unique per entity and a PM, entity and cost centre are required (YX-PRJ-01).
Given a billable project, when saved, then a client and billing model (T&M, fixed fee, retainer) are required (YX-PRJ-01).
Given budgets in hours, cost and fee, when set, then alert thresholds (starter 80 / 100 %) are saved (YX-PRJ-01).
Given a closed project, when time or costs are added, then they are refused (YX-PRJ-01).

title: Company sets project and timesheet policies from a template
story: As a PMO admin, I want project, timesheet and billing policies from a starter template so that we start fast and can override per project.
acceptance: Given a new company, when settings open, then the services-firm starter template (activity codes, internal codes, approval chain, 75 % target, 80 / 100 % alerts) is labelled as a starter (YX-PRJ-14).
Given a setting that allows it, when a PM overrides it on a project, then the override is saved for that project only (YX-PRJ-14).
Given imports, when clients, projects, tasks, allocations, rate cards and unbilled hours are loaded through P15, then opening WIP is set (M12 §8).

title: PM allocates people to a project
story: As a project manager, I want to allocate people by % or hours per week with a role so that only they book time and the bill rate is known.
acceptance: Given an allocation with role and dates, when saved, then the person can book time to the project on those dates (YX-PRJ-02).
Given Priya is allocated to ACME-Website, when she tries to book ACME-Mobile, then it is blocked (starter) or sent for PM approval per setting (YX-PRJ-02).
Given internal codes (training, bench, admin), when anyone books time, then they are always available (YX-PRJ-02).
Given `employment.exited`, when it fires, then the leaver's allocations end (M12 §6).

title: Account manager sets the project rate card
story: As an account manager, I want dated bill rates per role, per person or a project default so that invoices use the right rate.
acceptance: Given a rate card, when rates are added per role, person or default, hourly or daily, then they are dated (M12 §3).
Given a work date, when billing picks a rate, then it uses person override > project role > project default valid on that date (YX-PRJ-09).
Given bill rates, when anyone outside PM, account manager and finance looks, then they are hidden (M12 §4).

title: Project timesheets and approvals
Employee fills a weekly timesheet with project lines
story: As an employee, I want to fill my week with project, task and hours, pre-filled from my allocations, so that I submit once a week.
acceptance: Given the week grid, when it opens, then rows are pre-filled from allocations and pickers offer only allocated projects plus internal codes (YX-PRJ-02, YX-PRJ-03).
Given a day above 24 hours, when entered, then it is refused; above the shift's expected hours it warns (starter) (YX-PRJ-03).
Given a project requiring notes, when a line has none, then submit is blocked; billable defaults from the task, then the project (YX-PRJ-03).
Given a submitted week, when the employee tries to edit, then it is locked until sent back; placement and project lines share the week (YX-PRJ-03).

title: Employee submits the timesheet on the phone
story: As an employee, I want a day list on the Time tab to fill and submit my week so that I can do it on the go.
acceptance: Given the Time tab, when timesheets open, then each day lists rows pre-filled from allocations with project / task pickers (M04 §3.1, YX-MOB-01).
Given the week is done, when the employee taps 'submit week', then it is submitted (M04 §3.1).
Given approved or reduced lines, when the employee opens them, then reasons are shown (YX-PRJ-04).
Given reminders, when Friday comes, and on Monday when a week is missing, then nudges go out (M12 §6).

title: PM approves, reduces or rejects timesheet lines
story: As a project manager, I want to approve lines on cards grouped by project and week so that billing uses checked hours.
acceptance: Given submitted lines, when routed, then the PM approves (the PM's manager when the PM is the submitter; the account manager after the SLA) (YX-PRJ-04).
Given Priya's 42 h, when the PM reduces 2 h with 'duplicate stand-up entry', then she sees the reason (YX-PRJ-04).
Given lines within allocation, when the PM selects them, then they can bulk approve (M12 §7).
Given mobile, when the PM opens Requests, then timesheet approval cards are grouped by project and week, with milestone completion (M04 §3.1).

title: Client approves timesheets in the portal
story: As a client contact, I want to approve the hours billed to us in the portal so that invoices match what we agreed.
acceptance: Given a project with client approval on, when the PM has approved, then lines go to the client contact in the portal (YX-PRJ-04).
Given the client portal, when the contact signs in by email OTP, then they see only their client's projects and the lines billed to them (YX-PRJ-04).
Given hours awaiting client approval, when billing runs, then they stay in WIP and are not billed (YX-PRJ-09).

title: Approved time is corrected only with an adjustment line
story: As an employee, I want to fix approved time with an adjustment line so that the record stays honest.
acceptance: Given approved lines, when anyone tries to edit them, then it is refused (YX-PRJ-05).
Given a correction, when the employee adds it in an open week referencing the original, then it is approved like any line (YX-PRJ-05).
Given the P08 period lock, when it applies, then timesheet periods freeze and lock with it (YX-PRJ-05).

title: Payroll reads project hours only for timesheet-mode staff
story: As a payroll admin, I want project hours to affect pay only for timesheet-mode or rate-based staff so that monthly salaries don't change by mistake.
acceptance: Given an employee in Timesheet mode or with rate-based pay, when payroll runs, then approved hours feed pay through the M02 feed (YX-PRJ-13).
Given Rahul in Punch mode books 50 hours when attendance shows 40, when payroll runs, then pay is unchanged (YX-PRJ-13).
Given the mismatch, when found, then the PM sees a flag and nothing is auto-corrected (YX-PRJ-13).

title: Utilisation, costing and bench
Resource manager sees utilisation and capacity
story: As a resource manager, I want utilisation and capacity per person and team so that I keep people billable.
acceptance: Given approved billable hours and available hours (M02 expected hours minus leave and holidays), when computed, then Design team October = 1,120 ÷ 1,480 = 75.7 % (YX-PRJ-06).
Given capacity, when the board opens, then available − allocated hours show as a people × weeks heatmap (YX-PRJ-06).
Given a team of 3, when a non-HR viewer opens it where P02 says so, then it is suppressed (YX-PRJ-06).
Given a designation target (starter 75 %), when shown, then utilisation vs target is shown (YX-PRJ-06).

title: Project cost is computed from cost rates and expenses
story: As a finance user, I want project cost from approved hours × cost rate plus project expenses so that margin is known.
acceptance: Given approved hours, when the nightly job runs, then provisional cost = hours × the month's cost rate (YX-PRJ-07).
Given `payroll.run.paid` for October, when it arrives, then October postings are recomputed from final rates (YX-PRJ-07).
Given approved project-tagged expenses from M05, when approved, then they post to the project (YX-PRJ-07).
Given burn reaches 80 % or 100 % of hours, cost or fee, when it happens, then the PM and account manager are alerted (YX-PRJ-07).

title: PM sees cost totals without anyone's personal rate
story: As an employee, I want my cost rate hidden from my PM so that my pay stays private.
acceptance: Given individual cost rates, when a PM opens the project, then only payroll / finance scope sees them (YX-PRJ-08).
Given a one-person task in a month, when the PM views its cost, then it is suppressed (YX-PRJ-08).
Given finance, when they open the project, then they see margin and per-person cost (YX-PRJ-08).

title: Resource manager matches bench people to a resource request
story: As a resource manager, I want bench status and skill-matched suggestions for a PM's request so that bench people get work first.
acceptance: Given allocations, when computed, then each employee is allocated / partly allocated / bench, with bench age in days (YX-PRJ-17).
Given a PM's request for SQL at 100 % on given dates, when matched, then people with confirmed SQL skill and free on those dates are listed, bench first (YX-PRJ-17).
Given a person 100 % allocated on those dates, when matching runs, then they are not shown as available (YX-PRJ-17).
Given a match, when the resource manager confirms, then the allocation is created (YX-PRJ-17).

title: Client billing and accounting
Account manager bills time and material from WIP
story: As an account manager, I want to create invoices from approved billable hours so that we bill correctly and fast.
acceptance: Given 120 approved billable hours at ₹2,000 and 10 hours awaiting client approval, when the draft is created, then it bills ₹2,40,000 + GST only (YX-PRJ-09).
Given unapproved, non-billable or already invoiced hours, when billing runs, then they are never billed (YX-PRJ-09).
Given the WIP view, when opened, then everything billable not yet invoiced is listed by client and project (YX-PRJ-09).
Given the draft, when approved (starter: account manager → finance), then it is issued by the shared engine (YX-PRJ-11).

title: PM completes milestones to bill fixed-fee projects
story: As a project manager, I want milestones billed only when completed (and accepted) so that fixed-fee billing is correct.
acceptance: Given milestones of 30 / 40 / 30 % of ₹10 L, when they don't add up to the contract value, then a warning shows (YX-PRJ-10).
Given milestone 1 is completed and accepted by the client where needed, when billing runs, then ₹3 L becomes billable (YX-PRJ-10).
Given hours on a fixed-fee project, when logged, then they add cost but no invoice lines (YX-PRJ-10).
Given a retainer, when the company billing day comes, then its monthly amount is billed (YX-PRJ-10).

title: Correction after invoice creates a credit note
story: As a finance user, I want a correction to invoiced time to create a linked credit note so that the client and margin are right.
acceptance: Given invoiced time corrected down by 8 hours, when approved, then a credit note (or supplementary invoice) linked to the original invoice is created (YX-PRJ-15, YX-PRJ-05).
Given the company policy links corrections to pay recovery, when the credit note is created, then an M03 recovery line appears; with policy 'none', there is no recovery (YX-PRJ-15).
Given the correction, when posted, then that month's margin is restated, it is audited, and P08 locks are respected (YX-PRJ-15).

title: Old project invoices are blocked from e-invoicing after 30 days
story: As a finance user, I want a warning and a block for old invoices so that we don't break e-invoice reporting rules.
acceptance: Given an entity at or above the P07 e-invoice threshold, when a project invoice is 25 days old and not reported, then a warning shows (YX-PRJ-16).
Given the invoice is 31 days old, when sent for IRN, then it is blocked (YX-PRJ-16).
Given an entity below the threshold, when invoicing, then no guard applies (YX-PRJ-16).

title: Finance exports invoices and the project cost journal
story: As a finance user, I want invoices, receipts, credit notes and a monthly project cost journal exported with the project dimension so that the books show project profit.
acceptance: Given issued invoices, receipts and credit notes, when exported, then each carries the project dimension (YX-PRJ-12).
Given month end, when the project cost journal is exported, then payroll cost is reclassified from cost centre to project (YX-PRJ-12).
Given the same period and version, when exported again, then nothing is duplicated (YX-PRJ-12).
Given finance's revenue recognition, when they run the report, then WIP and fixed-fee progress are listed (YX-PRJ-12).

title: Establishments, contractors and licences
Compliance owner records the registration per establishment
story: As a compliance owner, I want each site's registration recorded and checked against the contract-worker count so that we never cross a threshold unregistered.
acceptance: Given an establishment, when the owner records the registration (OSH Code single registration or CLRA), then RC number, authority, maximum workers, nature of work and validity are saved (YX-CLRA-13).
Given active deployments cross the dated `IN.CLRA` threshold, when no valid registration exists, then a liability alert goes to the compliance owner (YX-CLRA-01).
Given dates before 21 Nov 2025, or a state without OSH rules, when the check runs, then CLRA 1970 values apply; otherwise OSH Code values (YX-CLRA-13).
Given registration expiry, when the lead times (starter 60 / 30 / 7 days) come, then alerts fire (YX-CLRA-02).

title: HR adds a contractor with licences and work orders
story: As an HR admin, I want to add a contractor with its licences and work orders so that only licensed contractors supply workers.
acceptance: Given a new contractor, when HR adds it, then PAN and bank are verified (P10) and an M03 vendor payee is created (M13 §6).
Given a licence, when added, then its scope (establishment / state / multi-state), maximum workers and validity are saved (YX-CLRA-13).
Given licence expiry, when the lead times come, then alerts fire (YX-CLRA-02).
Given a work order, when added, then scope, site, headcount, rate and period are saved (M13 §3).

title: Contractor representative uses the contractor portal
story: As a contractor's representative, I want my own login to manage my workers, proofs and bills so that I don't need to email HR.
acceptance: Given HR invites the representative, when they sign in by OTP, then they see only their own establishments, workers, packs and bills (YX-CLRA-11).
Given the contractor login, when billing runs, then it is not a billed seat (YX-CLRA-11, YX-CLRA-12).
Given the contractor is deactivated, when the representative tries to sign in, then the login has expired (YX-CLRA-11).

title: Contract workers and site attendance
Contractor submits workers linked to a person record
story: As a contractor's representative, I want to submit my workers so that they can be deployed.
acceptance: Given a worker, when submitted, then name, photo, masked ID, DOB, gender, skill category and wage rate are recorded (YX-CLRA-03).
Given a person already known (earlier deployment, past employee, applicant), when matched, then the worker links to that P01 person, not a duplicate (YX-CLRA-14).
Given the same person with another contractor, when submitted, then the duplicate check flags it (YX-CLRA-14).
Given a list import, when HR uploads it, then a dry-run validation shows errors first (M13 §8).

title: Site admin approves a deployment within licence limits
story: As a site admin, I want deployments checked for age, licence and limits before I approve so that we never break the law.
acceptance: Given a worker aged 17, when deployment is requested, then it is blocked (YX-CLRA-03).
Given a contractor licence allowing 30 at the site, when a 31st worker is deployed, then it is blocked with the limit shown (YX-CLRA-02).
Given a licence scoped to Tamil Nadu and Karnataka, when deploying at a Kochi site, then it is blocked with 'licence scope does not cover Kerala' (YX-CLRA-13).
Given approval, when it is given, then a gate pass with QR is issued and the kiosk / biometric enrolment is mapped to the person (YX-CLRA-14).

title: Licence and RC limits are re-checked every day
story: As a compliance owner, I want licence and RC limits checked every day so that expired licences or over-limit sites are caught.
acceptance: Given active deployments, when the daily check runs, then any contractor over its licence or RC maximum raises an alert (YX-CLRA-02).
Given a licence expires, when the daily check runs, then its deployments are flagged (YX-CLRA-02).
Given an alert, when resolved, then a note is required (YX-CLRA-07).

title: Contract workers check in at the site kiosk with a gate pass
story: As a contract worker, I want to check in with my gate pass so that my days on site are recorded.
acceptance: Given a valid gate pass, when the worker checks in at the M02 kiosk or a mapped biometric device, then the punch carries `person_type = contract_worker` (YX-CLRA-04).
Given contract-worker punches, when payroll and exceptions run, then they create no employee exceptions or payroll inputs (YX-CLRA-04).
Given a month's punches, when the pack is checked, then days on site come from them (YX-CLRA-04).
Given the worker later converts to employee, when they punch on the same device, then punches from the conversion date carry `person_type = employee` (YX-CLRA-14).

title: Site admin watches the on-site board
story: As a site admin, I want to see on-site workers per contractor against the work-order headcount so that I spot shortfalls.
acceptance: Given today's punches, when the board opens, then on-site count per contractor vs headcount shows (M13 §7).
Given a gate pass scan, when done at the board, then the worker's validity is shown (YX-CLRA-04).
Given a deployment ends, when released, then the gate pass is void, the device mapping removed and the worker kept in the register for the retention period (M13 §6).

title: Contract workers with attendance count as billable units
story: As the YukthiX billing owner, I want each contract worker with site attendance billed once per person so that pricing is fair.
acceptance: Given 60 workers with site attendance in November, when the invoice runs, then 60 HRMS units are added to that entity's invoice (YX-CLRA-12).
Given 5 registered workers absent all month, when billing runs, then they add nothing (YX-CLRA-12).
Given a person who is also a billable employee that month, when billing runs, then they are counted once (YX-CLRA-12).

title: Monthly compliance, alerts and contractor payment
Monthly compliance pack opens for each contractor and site
story: As a compliance owner, I want a monthly pack per contractor and site listing the proofs due so that I know what is missing.
acceptance: Given a wage month, when it starts, then a pack opens per contractor × establishment with the proofs company policy requires (starter: PF ECR + challan, ESI challan, wage register, payment proof) (YX-CLRA-05).
Given the due date (starter 15th of next month, never later than statutory dates), when proofs are still missing after it, then an overdue alert fires (YX-CLRA-05).
Given the matrix view, when opened, then contractor × proof type × status shows (M13 §7).

title: Verifier checks proofs with automatic checks
story: As a proof verifier, I want automatic checks beside each document so that I catch short challans and low wages.
acceptance: Given a proof uploaded by someone, when they try to verify it themselves, then it is refused; only another `clra.proof.verify` holder can (YX-CLRA-06).
Given an ESI challan for 40 workers when 52 had attendance, when checks run, then 'short challan' is flagged (YX-CLRA-06).
Given a wage below the P07 minimum for the state, zone and skill, when checks run, then it is flagged with the rule version (YX-CLRA-06).
Given days paid below days on site, when checks run, then a discrepancy is raised for the contractor to answer (YX-CLRA-06).

title: Compliance owner works liability alerts
story: As a compliance owner, I want alerts when we may become liable for a contractor's unpaid dues so that I act early.
acceptance: Given unpaid or below-minimum wages, short challans, an expired licence / RC, an over-limit deployment or an underage worker, when detected, then an alert goes to the compliance owner and site HR (YX-CLRA-07).
Given an alert, when shown, then the estimated potential liability is included (YX-CLRA-07).
Given an alert, when resolved, then a note is required and audited (YX-CLRA-07).

title: Contractor bill is held while the pack has open issues
story: As a finance user, I want contractor bills held while compliance items are overdue so that we don't pay a contractor who hasn't paid workers.
acceptance: Given the starter hold policy and an overdue October pack, when the October bill is approved, then M03 marks it held (YX-CLRA-08).
Given the compliance owner overrides with a reason, when saved, then the bill is released and the override audited (YX-CLRA-08).
Given the principal pays wages directly, when recorded, then the amount is recovered from the contractor's next bills (YX-CLRA-08).

title: Contractor bill is paid as a vendor invoice with TDS
story: As a finance user, I want contractor bills processed as vendor invoices with TDS 194C so that payments and tax are right.
acceptance: Given a contractor bill, when uploaded, then it links to its work order and the month's pack (YX-CLRA-09).
Given approval, when paid, then it goes through the M03 consultant / vendor invoice path with TDS s.194C and GST captured (YX-CLRA-09).
Given the contractor portal, when the representative opens bills, then payment status shows (YX-CLRA-11).

title: Registers and annual return are generated and signed
story: As a compliance owner, I want the principal-employer registers and returns generated in the right format so that inspections are easy.
acceptance: Given worker records, when the register is generated, then it uses the `IN.REGISTERS` format valid on the period date (YX-CLRA-03, YX-CLRA-10).
Given the period lock, when it applies, then registers are frozen and DSC-signed (YX-CLRA-10).
Given the year's data, when the annual return is drafted, then it uses the dated `IN.CLRA` format and is tracked in the compliance calendar (YX-CLRA-10).

title: Field force and pay-early on the phone
Field employee is tracked only on duty after consent
story: As a field sales employee, I want location tracking only during duty and only after I agree so that my privacy is respected.
acceptance: Given the store app, when the employee first uses field duty, then a consent sheet and the OS permission are both needed before tracking (YX-MOB-13).
Given duty check-in, when tracking runs, then a persistent OS notification 'YukthiX · Tracking on (duty)' and a 'Tracking on' chip show (YX-MOB-13).
Given check-out, shift end + grace or consent withdrawal, when it happens, then tracking stops at once and no location is requested after (YX-MOB-13).
Given the PWA, when used for field duty, then points are recorded only while it is open and it says so (YX-MOB-13).

title: Field employee checks in and out of planned visits
story: As a field employee, I want my beat plan and visit check-in with a photo so that my visits are recorded.
acceptance: Given today's beat plan, when the employee opens Time, then planned visits show (M04 §3.1).
Given a visit, when the employee checks in, then the photo is camera-only (no gallery) and stamped with time and location (YX-MOB-13).
Given the day ends, when distance is computed, then a draft mileage line goes to Pay › Expenses (YX-EXP-16).
Given a manager, when they open the Team segment, then the field team map shows during duty time only (M04 §3.1).

title: Employee draws pay early with the fee shown first
story: As an employee, I want to see the amount, fee and recovery month before I draw pay early so that there are no surprises.
acceptance: Given Pay › Get paid early, when opened, then re-authentication is required (YX-MOB-14).
Given the screen, when shown, then available amount, fee in rupees, who pays it and the recovery payroll month appear before the confirm button (YX-MOB-14).
Given a draw, when processed, then its status shows until recovered, and the push says only 'your request was processed' (YX-MOB-14).

title: Employee asks the WhatsApp assistant simple questions
story: As an employee, I want to ask my leave balance or a policy on WhatsApp so that I get quick answers.
acceptance: Given a message from a verified employee mobile, when it asks for leave balance, holidays or a policy, then the assistant answers on the company number (M04 Q6).
Given a payslip, salary or ID question, when asked, then the reply is an in-app link only (M04 Q6).
Given 'apply leave', when asked, then the assistant starts it and the employee confirms in-app by OTP link (M04 Q6).
Given an unknown number, when it messages, then nothing personal is answered (M04 Q6).

title: Talent, risk and market data
HR uses the 9-box and optional enforced distribution
story: As an HR admin, I want a 9-box of performance and potential and an optional enforced distribution so that talent reviews are structured.
acceptance: Given a potential rating added to the review, when calibration opens, then the 9-box view shows people by performance × potential (M06 Q5).
Given the company turns on enforced distribution, when the group breaks it, then calibration shows the variance and each change still needs a reason (M06 Q5, YX-PERF-08).
Given protected leave, when distribution is counted, then those people are not counted (YX-PERF-21).

title: HR adds people to talent pools and proposes successors
story: As an HR admin, I want confidential talent pools and to propose members as successors so that we have leaders ready.
acceptance: Given a 9-box or calibration outcome or a nomination, when HR adds someone to a pool, then a reason is required and audited (YX-PERF-16).
Given pool membership, when anyone other than HR or leadership looks, then it is hidden; the employee is told only if 'tell pool members' is on (YX-PERF-16).
Given a pool member, when HR proposes them as successor, then readiness is kept in M01 `succession_candidates` and shown here read-only, with their IDP linked (YX-PERF-16).

title: HR sees an advisory attrition-risk band
story: As an HR admin, I want an attrition-risk band with top factors, for HR only, so that I can act before good people leave.
acceptance: Given the company opted in, when monthly scoring runs, then it runs in-region from permitted inputs only (tenure, time since increment, compa-ratio, rating trend, manager changes, mobility, survey aggregates) (YX-PERF-17).
Given Special data, protected attributes or individual survey answers, when scoring runs, then they are never used (YX-PERF-17).
Given a manager opens Arun's profile, when they look, then no band shows; HR sees 'High — 26 months since last increment, compa-ratio 0.82', and every view is audited (YX-PERF-17).
Given a high band, when it is set, then no workflow, notification, rating, pay or exit step is triggered; HR logs actions by hand (YX-PERF-17).

title: HR adds market pay benchmarks to the comp review
story: As an HR admin, I want market P25–P75 ranges in the comp sheet from a partner feed or our own survey so that pay is competitive.
acceptance: Given no add-on, when HR uploads its own survey, then the comp sheet shows the market range and ratio with the upload date (YX-PERF-19).
Given the partner feed add-on, when queried, then only job-code queries go out and no employee data is sent (YX-PERF-19).
Given HR maps designation / grade / location to job codes, when the sheet loads, then market ratio = pay ÷ P50 shows beside compa-ratio (YX-PERF-19).
Given data older than the company-set age, when shown, then it is marked stale (YX-PERF-19).

title: Content providers, gamification and LTI
L&D connects LinkedIn Learning, Coursera or Udemy Business
story: As an L&D admin, I want our provider catalogue in YukthiX with our own licence so that external courses behave like ours.
acceptance: Given the company's own licence and credentials, when L&D connects a provider, then its catalogue syncs as external courses usable in rules, paths and IDPs (YX-LRN-10).
Given an enrolment, when pushed, then only name, work email and course ids are sent (YX-LRN-10).
Given the provider reports completion for neha@acme.com, when synced, then her enrolment completes and the certificate and competency update (YX-LRN-10).
Given a provider learner with a personal email, when unmatched, then it goes to the exceptions queue and no employee is created (YX-LRN-10).

title: Employee browses one marketplace of all courses
story: As an employee, I want one catalogue of own, provider and partner courses so that I find training in one place.
acceptance: Given the marketplace, when browsed, then filters by source, skill and duration work, and provider courses show the provider's name (M07 §7).
Given a partner content pack, when offered, then it is marked as an add-on (YX-LRN-10).
Given a sync failure, when it happens, then `learning.provider.sync_failed` alerts the L&D admin (M07 §6).

title: Company turns on learning points and leaderboards
story: As an HR admin, I want points, badges and leaderboards that employees can opt out of so that learning is fun but fair.
acceptance: Given the company switch is off, when employees open learning, then no gamification shows (YX-LRN-12).
Given the switch is on, when activities happen, then points are added to an append-only ledger (reversals as negative entries) from the starter rules (YX-LRN-12).
Given Ravi opts out, when the department board shows, then he is not on it but still sees his 120 points and badges (YX-LRN-12).
Given points and badges, when ratings, pay or M06 decisions run, then they are never used; leaderboards show points only (YX-LRN-12).

title: Certification is pushed to the company's Credly account
story: As an L&D admin, I want badges pushed to Credly so that employees can share them where they already are.
acceptance: Given a template with Credly on, when a certification is issued, then the badge is pushed to the company's Credly organisation (YX-LRN-13).
Given expiry or revocation, when it happens, then the Credly badge is updated (YX-LRN-13).
Given Credly fees, when used, then they are the customer's own contract (M07 §8).

title: Admin registers an external LMS for LTI 1.3
story: As a system admin, I want to register Moodle or Canvas as an LTI platform so that they can launch our courses and tests.
acceptance: Given an external LMS, when the admin registers issuer, client id, JWKS URL and deployment ids, then it is saved (YX-LRN-14).
Given Deep Linking, when an LMS course designer picks a YukthiX course or assessment, then a resource link is created (YX-LRN-14).
Given the launch log, when the admin opens Integrations, then each launch shows (M07 §7).

title: Learner launches from an external LMS and the grade goes back
story: As a learner in Moodle, I want to open a YukthiX assessment and have my score sent back so that I don't log in twice.
acceptance: Given a launch with verified claims, when the email matches an employee, then they are signed in as that employee (YX-LRN-14).
Given no match, when launched, then a guest learner is created, limited to the launched item (YX-LRN-14).
Given the attempt is scored, when done, then the grade is passed back to the LMS gradebook (YX-LRN-14).
Given a proctored assessment, when launched, then proctoring stays on, and a non-employee attempt is metered as a Proctoring attempt (YX-LRN-14).

title: Courses report progress through xAPI
story: As an L&D admin, I want xAPI content to report progress so that modern packages work too.
acceptance: Given an xAPI package, when the learner uses it, then statements are recorded against the enrolment (M07 Q1).
Given a completed statement, when received, then completion criteria are checked as for SCORM (YX-LRN-09, YX-LRN-01).
Given the player, when it runs, then it is sandboxed like SCORM (YX-LRN-09).

title: Open shifts, visitors and WFH presence on the phone
Employee claims open shifts and bids for shifts
story: As a nurse, I want to see open shifts I'm eligible for and claim them so that I can pick up extra work.
acceptance: Given open shifts, when the list loads, then only shifts the server finds eligible (skill, pool, conflicts, rest, hour caps) show (YX-MOB-15).
Given a claim, when made, then it shows 'Claimed · awaiting manager' and never assigns the shift until the award rule and approval complete (YX-MOB-15).
Given a bid window, when open, then the employee ranks preferences and days off and later sees the award (YX-MOB-15).
Given a manager, when they open Requests, then roster, claim and bid approval cards show (M04 §3.1).

title: Host approves a walk-in visitor from a push
story: As an employee host, I want a push with the visitor's photo and purpose so that I can approve in one tap.
acceptance: Given a walk-in for Ravi, when reception registers it, then Ravi gets an approval card with photo, name, company, purpose and location (YX-MOB-16).
Given Ravi taps approve, reject or 'send someone', when done, then the decision is recorded in one tap (YX-MOB-16).
Given no decision within the company timeout, when it passes, then the request returns to reception (YX-MOB-16).
Given the decision is made, when Ravi checks his phone, then the visitor photo is gone (YX-MOB-16).

title: Employee sees what WFH presence recorded today
story: As a work-from-home employee, I want to consent and see what was recorded today so that nothing is hidden from me.
acceptance: Given WFH presence is on, when the employee first opens it, then a consent sheet is shown (M04 §3.1).
Given consent, when the day goes on, then the employee sees first / last active and active hours recorded today (M04 §3.1).
Given consent is withdrawn, when it happens, then recording stops (M04 §3.1).

title: Corporate cards
Finance imports corporate card statements and matches them
story: As a finance user, I want card statements matched to receipts so that personal spend is recovered.
acceptance: Given a card statement CSV / bank format, when imported, then lines are auto-matched to receipts by amount, date and merchant (M05 Q8).
Given an unmatched line, when the employee is asked, then they explain it or mark it personal (M05 Q8).
Given personal spend, when confirmed, then it is recovered by the advance recovery route (M05 Q8, YX-EXP-09).
